# RL/docs/guides/nemotron-3-ultra.md at ultra-v3 · NVIDIA-NeMo/RL

Technical Report: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra Technical Report
This guide explains how to post-train the Nemotron 3 Ultra model with NeMo RL on
GB200 NVL72 (ARM64 / aarch64) hardware.
Overview
Nemotron 3 Ultra is post-trained with a multi-stage pipeline that mixes
Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), RLHF, and Multi-Teacher
On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) from a panel of specialised teacher models. The
main stages are:

Student RLVR — produces the student policy from the supervised
fine-tuning (SFT) checkpoint using GRPO with verifiable rewards.
Teacher training — trains a panel of teachers (the Student RLVR policy
itself serves as the general teacher, alongside specialised teachers such as
reasoning, instruction-following/abstention, RLHF chat, and SWE).
MOPD — on-policy distillation from the student into the teacher panel.

Every stage shares the same launcher (ultra_launch.sh) and a per-stage YAML
config under examples/configs/ultra/.
Checkpoint flow
The pipeline starts from an SFT checkpoint and produces a panel of teacher
checkpoints that, together with the Student RLVR output, feed MOPD. The Student
RLVR policy itself serves as the general teacher:
        ┌─────┐
        │ SFT │
        └──┬──┘
           v
    ┌──────────────┐
    │ Student RLVR │
    └──┬───────────┘
       │
       │   ┌────────────────────┐
       ├──>│  General Teacher   │──┐
       │   └────────────────────┘  │
       │   ┌────────────────────┐  │
       ├──>│  Reasoning Teacher │──┤
       │   └────────────────────┘  │
       │   ┌────────────────────┐  │
       ├──>│    RLHF Teacher    │──┤
       │   └────────────────────┘  │
       │   ┌────────────────────┐  │
       ├──>│  IFBench Teacher   │──┤
       │   └────────────────────┘  │
       │   ┌────────────────────┐  │
       ├──>│    SWE Teacher     │──┤
       │   └────────────────────┘  │
       │                           │
       v                           v
   ┌─────────┐               ┌──────────┐
   │ Student │──────────────>│   MOPD   │
   └─────────┘               └──────────┘

Container
These are the instructions to build the training container. The image targets
aarch64 (arm64) for GB200 NVL72 nodes and bundles a custom vLLM build
required by Ultra.
From the root of the repo:
docker buildx build \
  --progress=plain \
  -f docker/Dockerfile \
  --target release \
  -t nemo-rl-ultra:arm64 \
  --build-context nemo-rl=. \
  --build-arg MAX_JOBS=8 \
  --build-arg SKIP_SGLANG_BUILD=1 \
  --build-arg BUILD_CUSTOM_VLLM=1 \
  --build-arg BUILD_CUSTOM_VLLM_URL=https://github.com/TomerBN-Nvidia/vllm.git \
  --build-arg BUILD_CUSTOM_VLLM_REF=ultra-rl-v0.17 \
  --build-arg BUILD_CUSTOM_VLLM_PRECOMPILED_WHEEL_LOCATION=https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/releases/download/v0.17.0/vllm-0.17.0-cp38-abi3-manylinux_2_31_aarch64.whl \
  .
Build args:

BUILD_CUSTOM_VLLM=1 with BUILD_CUSTOM_VLLM_URL / BUILD_CUSTOM_VLLM_REF —
builds the Ultra vLLM fork; BUILD_CUSTOM_VLLM_PRECOMPILED_WHEEL_LOCATION
points at the matching upstream aarch64 wheel so the build reuses precompiled
kernels instead of compiling from source.
SKIP_SGLANG_BUILD=1 — Ultra runs on vLLM; skip the SGLang build.
MAX_JOBS — parallel build jobs; tune to your machine.
--build-context nemo-rl=. — build from your local checkout (otherwise the
Dockerfile pulls NVIDIA-NeMo/RL.git#main).

To run on the cluster with Slurm, convert the image to a squashfs (.sqsh)
with enroot:
enroot import -o nemo-rl-container.sqsh dockerd://nemo-rl-ultra:arm64
Pass the resulting image as CONTAINER in every launch command below (shown as
CONTAINER=/path/to/nemo-rl-container — a .sqsh path, or a registry image URI
if you're not using enroot). All Ultra stages run from this single image.
Download and prepare the data
The training blends are published as
nvidia/Nemotron-RL-Ultra-Training-Blends,
one JSONL per stage: rlvr1, rlvr2, ifbench, rlhf, reasoning, swe, and
mopd. Math rows that originate from BytedTsinghua-SIA/DAPO-Math-17k and
Skywork/Skywork-OR1-RL-Data ship as placeholders; the bundled
fill_placeholders.py restores them from the original datasets on Hugging Face.
export DATA_DIR=/path/to/ultra/data

# 1. Download the blends + fill_placeholders.py
huggingface-cli download nvidia/Nemotron-RL-Ultra-Training-Blends \
  --repo-type dataset --local-dir ultra-blends

# 2. Restore the DAPO / Skywork placeholders into $DATA_DIR
cd ultra-blends
./fill_placeholders.py --input-dir . --output-dir "$DATA_DIR"   # requires uv
This produces $DATA_DIR/{rlvr1,rlvr2,ifbench,rlhf,reasoning,swe,mopd}.jsonl. Hold
out the last 100 rows of each blend as a validation split — the launch commands
below consume <name>.train.jsonl as TRAIN_PATH and <name>.val.jsonl as
VAL_PATH:
cd "$DATA_DIR"
for name in rlvr1 rlvr2 ifbench rlhf reasoning swe mopd; do
  head -n -100 "$name.jsonl" > "$name.train.jsonl"
  tail -n 100   "$name.jsonl" > "$name.val.jsonl"
done
By electing to use the external datasets you are responsible for confirming their
licenses are fit for your intended use.
The SWE stage additionally requires per-instance .sif container images built
from SWE-Gym and SWE-rebench-V2 — see SWE Teacher for the build
steps.
For now, each stage takes a JSONL training file and a JSONL validation file
(see Launch script below).
Prepare the code
git clone --recursive -b ultra-v3 https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/RL.git
cd RL
Prepare the starting checkpoint
If your starting checkpoint comes from Hugging Face or is the result of SFT with
Megatron-Bridge, it is a transformers v5 checkpoint. NeMo RL runs an older
transformers v4, so convert the checkpoint to a v4-compatible version before
using it as MODEL_PATH.
The converter rewrites config.json, adds the v4 modeling files, and symlinks
the weight shards back to the source checkpoint.
python examples/converters/ultra/convert_ultra_ckpt_t5_to_t4.py \
  --source /path/to/ultra_sft_checkpoint_v5 \
  --output /path/to/ultra_sft_checkpoint_v4 \
  --force
Use the converted directory (/path/to/ultra_sft_checkpoint_v4) as MODEL_PATH
in the launch commands below. The converter copies the bundled v4 NemotronH
modeling files (configuration_nemotron_h.py / modeling_nemotron_h.py in examples/converters/ultra/) into the output
automatically (the default --runtime-source); pass --runtime-source <dir> to
override.
Build the sandbox container
Several Gym environments used during
training (notably ns_tools for stateful Python execution with math
verification, and math_formal_lean for Lean4 proof verification) rely on a
sandbox container. Build it from the
NeMo-Skills Dockerfile:
git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Skills.git
cd Skills
git checkout b620e79   # Skills commit pinned for the Ultra release
docker build -t nemo-skills-sandbox:latest -f dockerfiles/Dockerfile.sandbox .
For SLURM clusters using enroot, convert
to a .sqsh:
enroot import -o nemo-skills-sandbox.sqsh dockerd://nemo-skills-sandbox:latest
Launch script
Every stage is submitted with ultra_launch.sh at the repo root. The launcher
handles SLURM submission, code snapshotting, persistent cache management, and
container mounts — stage-specific hyperparameters (batch size, advantage clip,
MoE parallelism, learning rate) live in the per-stage YAML.
Set the following before each bash ultra_launch.sh invocation:



Variable
Purpose




EXP_NAME
Job name, W&B run name, and the suffix for output directories. Must be unique per run; same name across resubmissions resumes from the latest checkpoint.


CONFIG_PATH
Path to the per-stage YAML config (e.g. examples/configs/ultra/student_rlvr.yaml).


MODEL_PATH
Initial policy checkpoint (HuggingFace repo id or local path). Student RLVR starts from the Ultra SFT checkpoint; the teacher stages start from the Student RLVR checkpoint; MOPD starts from the student (the Student RLVR checkpoint).


TRAIN_PATH
Training data JSONL.


VAL_PATH
Validation data JSONL.


CONTAINER
NeMo RL container image (.sqsh path or registry image URI).


SANDBOX_CONTAINER
Sandbox image from Build the sandbox container.


PERSISTENT_CACHE
Directory on a shared filesystem (e.g. Lustre) where vLLM/Triton/Inductor compile caches are persisted across runs.


EXTRA_MOUNTS
Comma-separated host:container mount pairs for any shared filesystems holding your data, model checkpoints, and PERSISTENT_CACHE (e.g. EXTRA_MOUNTS=/lustre:/lustre,/scratch:/scratch).


SLURM_PARTITION, SLURM_ACCOUNT
Your SLURM cluster credentials.


GENRM_MODEL
GenRM judge: HF repo id or local path. Default is nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B-GenRM. Served in-cluster from the gym pool at TP=4 DP=4 (16 GPUs). Required unless GENRM_BASE_URL is set.


GENRM_BASE_URL
Optional. URL of a separately-deployed GenRM service (e.g. http://genrm-host:9213/v1). If set, routes judging to that endpoint and ignores GENRM_MODEL. Useful when sharing a single GenRM deployment across many training jobs.


NL2BASH_JUDGE_MODEL
NL2Bash / general-purpose judge: HF repo id or local path. Default judge is Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507-FP8.


SAFETY_JUDGE_MODEL
Content-safety judge: HF repo id or local path. Default is nvidia/Nemotron-Content-Safety-Reasoning-4B.

The launcher reports the experiment directory layout, sample monitoring
commands, and (on submission) the SLURM job id.
Stage 2 — Teacher training
The teacher panel is a set of specialised RL runs that each start from the
Student RLVR output (Stage 1) (see Checkpoint flow above). Each teacher
runs independently with its own YAML config under examples/configs/ultra/.
The teachers don't depend on each other and can run in parallel.
IFBench Teacher
RLHF teacher specializing in instruction following, abstention, and refusal
behavior. Trained at 49k context with a smaller batch (GBS=2048) and lower
learning rate (lr=2.5e-6) than the student RLVR stage.

Reasoning Teacher
General reasoning teacher. The training data subsamples an RLVR
blend, where every prompt is graded by the equivalence_llm_judge agent
(LLM-judge equivalence over freeform short answers). The output checkpoint
serves the code_gen, ns_tools, math_with_judge,
equivalence_llm_judge, and mcqa agent slots in MOPD — one checkpoint,
many roles.

Software-engineering RLVR teacher trained against code execution. The
swe_agents agent runs the policy's candidate fixes inside apptainer (.sif)
container images for each SWE-Gym / SWE-rebench-V2 instance and rewards
the rollout based on test pass/fail.

Each rollout runs inside a per-instance apptainer (.sif) image resolved from
${SIF_DIR} via the agent's container_formatter. Since this recipe targets
GB200 (aarch64) and the upstream SWE images ship for x86 only, the images must
be rebuilt for ARM — one per instance — then converted to .sif. The resulting
directory is reused across runs.

1. Prerequisites. Docker, Apptainer, and uv on the build host. Build on an
ARM64 (GB200) node so images are natively aarch64 with no emulation. You also
need a container registry to publish to: set REGISTRY to its endpoint and
docker login to it first. The build scripts push every per-instance image
there, and the conversion step (3) pulls them back to produce the .sif files —
so the registry must be reachable from both the build and the convert hosts.
Install Apptainer on the build host via the official PPA, pinned to the version
the training container ships (so the .sif format matches — see
docker/install_apptainer.sh):
sudo add-apt-repository -y ppa:apptainer/ppa
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y "apptainer=1.5.0-2-1~$(. /etc/os-release && echo "$VERSION_CODENAME")"

Storage. The registry accumulates ~7,800 images, plus the converted .sif
set on the build host. The pushed images can be deleted once every .sif has
been built.

2. Build the per-instance images.

# Kimi K3 技术报告 — 后训练方法学笔记

**论文**：《Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence — Technical Report of Kimi K3》，Kimi Team（arXiv 2607.24653，47 页）

> ⚠️ 首先更正一点：论文中该技术的实际名称是 **MOPD（Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation，多教师在线策略蒸馏）**，不是 "MTOP"。

## 1. 模型基本信息

- 2.78T 总参数（摘要写作 2.8T）MoE，激活参数 104.2B（Table 1，K2 为 1.04T/32.6B）
- 93 层（1 层 dense），隐藏维度 7168，词表 160K
- 混合注意力：每 block 3 层 KDA（Kimi Delta Attention，线性注意力）+ 1 层 Gated MLA，共 69 KDA + 24 MLA；NoPE（无显式位置编码）
- Stable LatentMoE：896 个 routed experts，每 token 激活 16 个（稀疏度 56），2 个 full-width shared experts，latent 维度 3584，单 expert 隐藏维度 3072
- 原生多模态：MoonViT-V2（401M 参数、27 层、patch 14），语言+视觉从头联合预训练
- 上下文：预训练 8K→64K，cooldown 阶段 256K→1M，最终支持 100 万 token
- 1 个 MTP（multi-token prediction）层；预训练优化器为 Per-Head Muon + weight clipping，cosine LR、1% linear warmup、weight decay 0.1
- **预训练总 token 数：论文未披露**（只提到用 scaling law 重调 TPP 等超参）

## 2. 后训练整体 Pipeline（§4.1）

三阶段范式，顺序与目的：

1. **SFT**：建立 cold-start 基线 agent 策略
2. **RL**：在 3 个领域 × 3 个推理强度（low/high/max）上各训一个专家模型，共 **9 个领域专家**
3. **MOPD**：把 9 个领域-强度专家的能力蒸馏合并回单一模型

另有部署感知的后训练（§4.1.4）：全程 QAT + EAGLE-3 draft model 微调。

## 3. QAT 细节（§4.1.1、§4.1.4）

- **量化格式**：MoE expert 权重 → **MXFP4**；expert 输入激活 → **MXFP8**（非 NVFP4/INT4）
- **量化范围**：只量化 MoE routed expert 权重（占参数内存主体）；attention 投影、latent MoE 投影、shared experts、MoE router 全部保持高精度
- **覆盖阶段**：**从 SFT 阶段开始，贯穿整个后训练（SFT + RL 全程 QAT）**，让模型适应量化精度损失；RL 中 rollout 与训练共享同一量化方案，消除训练-推理不一致
- **与 pretraining 的关系**：预训练在 BF16/FP8 体系下完成（激活用 block-wise FP8 是训练显存优化），QAT 是后训练阶段引入的部署感知改造；EAGLE-3 draft 微调也遵循同一 QAT 配置
- **学习率、token 数、训练时长、步数：论文均未披露**

## 4. SFT 细节（§4.1.1）

- 沿用此前 Kimi 系列（K2/K2.5）SFT pipeline，大幅扩展复杂 agentic 任务覆盖
- 数据来源：用**上一代 Kimi 系列的领域专门模型合成轨迹** → 多阶段验证 + human-in-the-loop 标注
- 所有数据用自研 **XTML**（eXtensible Token Markup Language）chat template 序列化（附录 F）
- 目标能力：自适应推理、精确工具调用、长程 agentic 执行
- **数据规模、训练超参（LR、epoch、batch）：论文未披露**

## 5. RL 细节（§4.1.2、§4.2）

**组织结构**：3 大领域——(i) general tasks（通用体验、视觉、推理、忠实性、搜索、知识工作）、(ii) general agents（长程助手、深度研究、段落级写作）、(iii) coding agents（SWE、coding 体验、kernel、Web 开发）——× 3 档推理强度 {low, high, max} = 9 个专家。

**算法**：
- **未点名 GRPO/PPO**；policy optimization "follows the algorithm in Kimi K2.5"，依靠 **per-token regularization** 把策略更新约束在局部邻域，从而容忍 partial rollout 带来的极端 off-policy/陈旧数据
- **Partial rollout**：每 iteration 对 N 个 prompt 各采 K 条（共 N×K 条轨迹），完成比例到 λ∈(0,1) 即暂停生成进入优化，暂停的轨迹入队、下一 iteration 优先恢复（由可恢复 microVM 沙箱支撑）
- **Reasoning effort RL**：每题初始预算 b₀(x)（由 cold-start 模型估计），超出 τ·b₀(x) 的轨迹 reward 直接覆写为 −1；先用大 τ 训 max 档，再逐步退火 τ 得到 high/low 档；通用任务按 thinking tokens 计，agentic 任务按累计输出 tokens（含工具调用参数）计
- **Reward**：可验证任务用规则/verifier；不可验证通用任务用 **Agentic Generative Reward Model (GRM)**，沿用 K2.5 的锦标赛式二元比较组奖励，judge 须执行强制协议（读产出→生成 rubric→按 rubric 打分→记入 scorepad）；防啰嗦 hacking：超过 σ·ℓ₀ 长度自动判负

**环境/任务合成（§4.2）**：统一白盒环境（harness 模块化为工具接口/系统提示/上下文管理/skills/记忆/子 agent，可实例化 Kimi Code、Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw、Hermes）；知识图谱引导的任务合成（agent 递归扩展 DAG + 网络检索材料）；可验证 agentic 任务（多步搜索、投行/数据分析/法律等专业工作、视觉推理 in-the-loop）；kernel 优化任务（CUDA/Triton/CuTe DSL/Gluon/ThunderKittens/TileLang，正确性过阈值得 0、追平专家实现得 0.5、逼近 roofline 趋近 1，带 anti-hacking 检测）；个人助理 mock 应用（Gmail/Notion/Slack/Canvas，单条 rollout 可达数千次工具调用、百万级 context tokens）；Autonomous Execution Tasks（verifier-in-the-loop，公开+隐藏双 verifier，限提交次数的惩罚式奖励）；Web 开发任务（确定性检查 + 模型评审，构建失败/造假直接零分）。

**规模/超参数字**：RL FLOPs 扩展曲线见 Figure 8（无量纲坐标），**具体步数、batch size、学习率、λ 取值：论文未披露**。

## 6. MOPD 细节（§4.1.3）

- **全称**：Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation，多教师在线策略蒸馏；引用 [75]（Thinking Machines 的 on-policy distillation）、[134]（MiMo-V2-Flash）、[29]（DeepSeek-V4）
- **教师构成**：9 个 RL 领域-强度专家；给定领域 d、采样强度 e∈{low, high, max}，由对应教师 π_teacher^(d,e) 指导（按 domain/effort 路由到对应教师）
- **损失/奖励形式**：不用 KL 散度，而是把**逐 token 的 log 比率奖励**嵌入 RL 框架：
  r_opd(y_t | e, x, y_<t) = clip( sg[ log( π_teacher^(d,e)(y_t|x,y_<t) / π_θ(y_t|e,x,y_<t) ) ], −R_max, R_max )
  sg 为 stop-gradient，R_max>0 截断极端优势信号稳训；学生从自身 rollout（on-policy）上计算该 dense reward
- **优势**：与 RL 基础设施（如 partial rollout）无缝兼容；试过更细粒度 top-k 蒸馏目标，收敛速度和最终性能均无明确收益
- 各强度专家产出的轨迹也同时被收集用于 SFT 与 MOPD

**附：EAGLE-3 draft 微调（§4.1.4）**：把预训练 MTP 层微调为 EAGLE-3 式 draft（target 冻结，只训 draft 层+特征融合投影）；训练时展开 7 步；融合第 1/4/最后一个 AttnRes block 的低/中/高层特征；直接优化 LK loss L_LK = −log Σ_x min(p(x), q(x))（温度 1，无辅助 CE 项）。

## 7. 开源情况

- **权重**：完整开放，https://huggingface.co/moonshotai/Kimi-K3

## 二、Nemotron 3 Ultra 后训练（[技术报告](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/nemotron/files/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-Technical-Report.pdf))

**模型**:550B-A55B hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE(LatentMoE 512 experts 选 22,2 个共享权重 MTP 层）,**NVFP4 预训练** 20T token,LC 阶段扩到 1M 上下文。

**Pipeline(Figure 9):Base → SFT → RLVR → MOPD Warmup → MOPD ×2 轮 → MTP Boosting → Final**

### 1. SFT（两阶段，配置全披露）
- Stage 1:pack 到 288K,GBS 64,204,800 samples,LR 峰值 1.5e-5;Stage 2:pack 到 515K,19,200 samples,LR 峰值 1e-5；保留 MTP 辅助 loss(0.1)
- 数据极其详细地披露：512K 长上下文合成、GPT-OSS-120B medium-effort 样本、安全 135K 六语种、搜索（OpenResearcher 21.7K 等）、终端 ~370K、数学/证明 1.8M+1.9M(Nemotron-Cascade-2)、代码 1.2M Python + 1.0M C++ + 1.3M tool-calling、CUDA ~100K、RTL ~1.2M 等

### 2. RLVR（统一混合环境 GRPO)
- **异步 GRPO**，环境覆盖 terminal/SWE/搜索/数学/代码/安全/聊天等 15 类，每类任务至少 2 种 harness 防过拟合执行格式
- 规模：GBS 8192，每 sample 16 rollouts，生成长度 48K→64K;~2.5% 提示为 medium-effort 模式（最终省 ~2.5× token、精度降 ~7%)
- LR、clip 等未披露（但 NeMo RL 的 YAML 配置里有，见下文）

### 3. MOPD（核心，2 轮迭代）
- 目标：学生在自己生成的 prefix 上逐 token 最小化对教师的 reverse KL;**异步三路流水**(rollout / teacher 打分 / learner)，行为策略与信任域中心解耦，PPO 式 clip,token mask 用 IcePop
- 配置：最大生成 192K，每 batch 1024 prompt × 1 rollout（多 rollout 无收益）
- **教师 panel**:Iteration 1 = STEM、Chat、IF、Terminal、工具调用、SWE、Search、Office、Usability、Agentic Safety(+ RLVR Student 自教）;Iteration 2 再分化出 Coding/Chat 2/SWE 2 等新教师 → Ultra Final
- **MOPD Warmup 是关键发现**:pipeline 差异大的教师直接合并效果差（学生轨迹对教师 OOD)，先做极轻 SFT 对齐分布 —— GDPVal 恢复率 46.7 vs 35.3（无 warmup)
- Recovery 普遍 67%–172%;HLE 仅 16.9%（教师优势来自离线数据，on-policy 信号覆盖不到）

### 4. MTP Boosting
- backbone 冻结只训 MTP 头，温度 2 的 forward-KL 蒸馏，12K 步、GBS 64；投机解码接受长度 4.387→4.584,RL rollout 生成 **1.46× 加速**

### 5. 量化：纯 PTQ，无 QAT
- 注意与 Kimi K3 的关键区别：Ultra 是 **NVFP4 预训练 + 后训练后 PTQ**(Model-Optimizer),BF16 vs NVFP4 精度基本无损；论文全文无 QAT

### 6. 开源（最大的差异点）
- **Checkpoint**:NVFP4 / BF16 / Base BF16 / **GenRM judge** 全开放
- **数据**:`nvidia/Nemotron-RL-Ultra-Training-Blends`(rlvr1/rlvr2/ifbench/rlhf/reasoning/swe/mopd 七个 JSONL,DAPO/Skywork 占位符可回填）、Nemotron-Posttraining-v3、预训练数据系列
- **代码**：全部开源，两个入口：
  - [NVIDIA-NeMo/RL `ultra-v3` 分支](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/RL/blob/ultra-v3/docs/guides/nemotron-3-ultra.md)：完整 RL 复现指南 —— `ultra_launch.sh` + 每阶段 YAML(`student_rlvr1/2.yaml`、`ifbench_teacher.yaml`、`rlhf_teacher.yaml`、`reasoning_teacher.yaml`、`swe_teacher.yaml`、`mopd.yaml`)，两阶段 Student RLVR(49K→65K 上下文，GBS 8192 = 512 prompt × 16 gen,advantage clip ±20),MOPD 教师路由表（agent → teacher checkpoint）都写死在 YAML 里
  - [NVIDIA-NeMo/Nemotron `ultra3` recipe](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Nemotron/tree/main/src/nemotron/recipes/ultra3):Pretrain + SFT 的数据准备和训练（Megatron-Bridge),`uv run nemotron ultra3 ...` 一条命令跑
- **明确的限制**：两轮 MOPD 的中间 teacher checkpoint 和 MOPD1 checkpoint 未发布，**完整两轮 pipeline 无法 1:1 复现**，指南只演示代表性的单轮（Student RLVR → 小 panel → 一次 MOPD);SWE 阶段的 ~7,800 个 per-instance ARM 容器镜像需要自己重建

---

## 三、两者对比

| 维度 | Kimi K3 | Nemotron 3 Ultra |
|---|---|---|
| 量化策略 | **QAT 贯穿 SFT+RL 全程**(MXFP4 权重 + MXFP8 激活，仅 MoE expert) | NVFP4 **预训练**；后训练全程 BF16，最后 **PTQ**（无 QAT) |
| RL 组织 | 3 领域 × 3 强度 = **9 个专家** 并行 | 先统一混合 **RLVR Student**，再分化 **10+ 专门 teacher** |
| MOPD 形式 | log 比率 **dense reward 嵌入 RL 循环**，按 (domain, effort) 路由 | reverse KL + PPO clip，异步三路流水，按 agent → teacher checkpoint 路由，**2 轮迭代 + Warmup** |
| 教师来源 | RL 专家本身 | RLVR Student（自教）+ 各专门 RL teacher |
| 推理强度控制 | RL 阶段直接训 low/high/max 三档专家 | SFT 初始化 medium-effort + RLVR 长度 reward(2.5% 混入） |
| 投机解码 | EAGLE-3 微调 MTP 层（LK loss) | MTP Boosting（冻结 backbone,T=2 forward-KL) |
| 复现可行性 | 仅权重，方法学参考 | **数据、代码、配置、judge 模型全开**，但需 GB200 集群（单 stage 64–224 节点）+ 中间 checkpoint 缺失 |

方法学上两者确实是同一路线：**“先 RL 出一组专门化教师，再用 on-policy 蒸馏合并回单一学生”**，且都把稀疏注意力/线性注意力大 MoE + MTP + FP4 量化作为效率底座。Kimi K3 的增量在于把蒸馏做成 RL reward（复用 partial rollout 基建）和全程 QAT;NVIDIA 的增量在于 MOPD Warmup 消融、两轮迭代和完整的工程开放。

## 四、如果你想动手复现

- 唯一可端到端走通的路径是 NVIDIA 这套：数据 `nvidia/Nemotron-RL-Ultra-Training-Blends` + NeMo RL `ultra-v3` 分支。但硬件门槛很高（指南默认 GB200 NVL72,Student RLVR 用 256 个 4-GPU 节点，MOPD 用 224 节点）
- 若你只有小规模集群，可行做法是**借用方法学、缩小规模**:NeMo RL 主线支持 GRPO 和 on-policy distillation，可以对小模型复刻 "RLVR student → 少量 teacher → 单轮 MOPD";QAT 路线则可参考 K3 的做法（只量化 MoE expert,rollout 与训练同量化方案），工具上用 NVIDIA Model-Optimizer 或 auto-round（你本地 `lkk/` 目录下已有这两个相关仓库）

两篇提取好的全文文本在 `/tmp/kimi_k3.txt` 和 `/tmp/nemotron_ultra.txt`。需要的话我可以进一步：对比两份 MOPD 的公式细节、深入读 NeMo RL 的 `mopd.yaml` / `student_rlvr.yaml` 具体超参，或者基于你的硬件条件给一个缩小版的复现方案。

L1367–1428 是全报告数据描述最细的一段：种子四来源（Nemotron-Science-v1 公开 HF 数据集[L1388 脚注19]、化学数据集、Multi-subject-RLVR、**"an internal proprietary dataset"** L1370–1371)；每题 4 条 trace、难题 16 条（L1372–1373);gpt-oss-120b 做 judge(L1374)；中位正确解 >16k token 的子集重采 8 条（L1375–1376);3000 题留出集 pass-rate 0.25–0.80(L1376–1378)。数学：95,164 题→285,516 COT + 259,915 TIR(L1395–1400)；证明：5,751 AoPS 题→82,737 条（L1402–1410)；竞赛代码 ~14K+4K OpenCodeReasoning、10 候选编译过滤（L1379–1387)。配比：40B token = 科学 23.5B(58.75%)+ 数学 9.45B(23.63%)+ 竞赛代码 4.05B(10.13%)+ 通用 3.0B(7.50%)(L1413–1418),packing 到 294,912(L1421)。两个卡点：内部专有种子、trace 由 **DeepSeek-V4-Pro（闭源 API，原文 "the model provider's recommended generation parameters" L1396–1397)** 生成。

### 8. Office/GDPval teacher 的 AfterQuery rollout — **级别 3**
> "We then constructed a training distribution from AfterQuery (AQ) tasks that share important latent structure with GDPval…For each AQ task, we used a strong model to generate multiple full trajectory rollouts…light SFT…then…pivot RL…using pivots derived from the strong model's AQ rollouts."(L1251–1259)

AfterQuery 任务集非公开、teacher 只称 "a strong model"、无规模无配比，仅流程（轻 SFT→pivot RL）清楚。

### 9. Search teacher 上下文管理 SFT 轨迹 — **级别 2**
> "SFT on trajectories augmented with context-management behavior…including discard-all resets and summary-based compression. We focus primarily on discard-all context management, where earlier search observations are removed once the interaction history exceeds the context budget"(L1265–1271)

策略概念清楚（discard-all 重置 + 摘要压缩），但轨迹从哪来、谁生成、多少条、如何"augment"，全部未述。

### 10. Terminal-use teacher 1 小时专家轨迹 — **级别 2（轨迹来源级别 3)**
> "We start with expert trajectories for tasks that was curated to challenge the model in long timeout settings, where the model needs to run the task for up-to one hour. We utilize PivotRL…with re-profiling steps whenever we observe accuracy saturation."(L1272–1275)

仅两句。专家轨迹的 curate 方式完全未述；PivotRL 有公开论文（L1274 引用）。

### 11. Chat teacher 多轮 RLHF 定向补弱数据 — **级别 3**
> "Chat teacher training involves multiple RLHF iterations. After each iteration, we evaluate the policy model on internal chat benchmarks, identify weaknesses, and curate targeted data to address them."(L1328–1330)

内部 benchmark + 未说明的"targeted data"构造方式；唯一具体机制是 principle-following GenRM(L1320–1327，可按原则打三元组分，RLHF 只用 overall score)。

### 12. MOPD warmup 轻量 SFT — **级别 2**
> "the student undergoes a very light SFT on data drawn from the teacher's training distribution…align the student's reasoning trajectories and output distribution with those expected by the teacher."(L1449–1452)

动机（分布失配，L1442–1447）和 ablation(GDPVal 46.7 vs 35.3,L1461）都给了，但 warmup 数据规模、采样方式未述，且"teacher's training distribution"本身部分未公开。

### 13. MOPD Iteration 2 新 teacher 数据 — **级别 3**
正文只有一句流程性描述：

Figure 10(L1107–1155）列出 Iteration 2 新增 Chat Teacher 2 / Coding Teacher / Conversational tool-use Teacher 2 / SWE Teacher 2 / Office work Teacher 2 / Agentic Safety Teacher，但各 teacher 的数据配方零描述（Coding Teacher 全文无对应小节）。

## B. Kimi K3 可用于弥补的合成方法（原文引用）

**B1. 统一白盒 RL 环境（模块化 harness)** — §4.2.1, L1044–1056:
> "represents an agent harness as a collection of configurable, composable modules, including tool interfaces, system prompts, context management strategies, skills, memories, subagents"(L1047–1049)；可实例化 "Kimi Code, Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, and Hermes"(L1049–1050);RL 中 "dynamically construct different harness configurations for different task groups"(L1054–1055)。

**B2. 知识图谱引导任务合成** — §4.2.2, L1057–1103:
> DAG "through recursive, agent-driven expansion…An agent instance is then assigned to each node and performs multiple web searches…explores the existing graph to identify equivalent or related concepts, reuse existing nodes…A branch stops expanding when the assigned agent determines that the current concept is sufficiently atomic."(L1091–1098)
> "Keywords derived from the sampled nodes are combined with contextual information from their ancestors…to formulate web queries. The retrieved real-world materials are assembled so that a synthesis agent produces training tasks of various task types."(L1100–1103)

**B3. 可验证 agentic 任务** — §4.2.3, L1104–1117：多步复杂信息搜索（规划→逐步取证→"a verifiable answer" L1107)；专业人士日常工作（投行/数据分析/法律，沙盒中操作领域工具，"dozens to hundreds of steps" 产出 deliverable, L1110–1112)；视觉推理（隔离沙盒 + Python 解释器，迭代裁剪/缩放/计算/验证，L1113–1117)。

**B4. Kernel 优化任务** — §4.2.4, L1118–1128:
> "CUDA, Triton, CuTe DSL, Gluon, ThunderKittens, and TileLang…BF16, FP8, and FP4…each kernel provides a PyTorch reference implementation, and solutions exceeding a predefined numerical error threshold receive zero reward. Performance is scored against an expert implementation, where matching it yields a reward of 0.5 and approaching the hardware roofline increases the reward toward 1…a hacking-detection system that penalizes…CUDA graph replay, input caching, and precision reduction"(L1121–1128)

**B5. 个人助理 mock 应用** — §4.2.5, L1129–1139:
> "realistic mock implementations of widely used applications, such as Gmail, Notion, Slack, and Canvas…persistent, evolving environment over multiple simulated days…up to thousands of tool calls and millions of context tokens. Each event carries its own evaluation criterion, assessed by deterministic rules or LLM-based evaluators. The initial workspace is constructed by agents that autonomously search the web for reference materials"(L1130–1138)

**B6. Autonomous Execution Tasks（双 verifier)** — §4.2.6, L1140–1151:
> "an initial state, a constrained goal, a tool-based action space, execution budgets, and an independent verifier…without reference trajectories…Rewards are grounded in the verifier's evaluation of the final environment state…pairing public verifiers that offer diagnostic feedback with hidden verifiers that evaluate held-out scenarios, and applying penalty-based rewards under limited submission budgets"(L1142–1151)

**B7. Web 开发任务** — §4.2.7, L1152–1160：容器化沙盒 + 多样 scaffold;deterministic checks（构建失败/造假直接零分 L1159)+ 内部 RM 做源码审查与产物交互评判。

**B8. SFT 轨迹合成（上一代专门模型+多阶段验证+HITL)** — §4.1.1, L907–913:
> "we synthesize data trajectories using domain-specialized models from the prior Kimi series, followed by multi-stage verification and human-in-the-loop annotation…serialize all data with our XTML-based chat template"(L909–912)

**B9. Reasoning effort 预算控制（τ·b₀）与专家轨迹回收** — §4.1.2, L962–971:
> "associate each problem x with an initial token budget b0(x) estimated from the cold-start model, and override the task reward with −1 for trajectories whose total token budget T(y) exceeds a scaled threshold τ·b0(x)…stage-wise curriculum over the budget multiplier τ…anneal τ to smaller values to obtain the high- and low-effort expert models…Trajectories produced by the resulting experts at all reasoning levels are jointly collected for supervised fine-tuning and multi-teacher on-policy distillation."(L963–971)

**B10. Agentic GRM** — §4.1.2, L972–979：强制协议"read outcome→generate rubric→score against rubric→record in scorepad"(L974–976)；冗长惩罚 "σ·ℓ0 自动判负"(L977–979)。

**B11. MOPD(3 域 × 3 强度 = 9 专家）** — §4.1.3, L980–1007:per-token OPD reward、clip 到 ±Rmax（式 15, L991–1003);9 专家矩阵见 L923–924。

**B12. Draft model 微调（MTP→EAGLE-3)** — §4.1.4, L1015–1039:7 步展开模拟推理时递归起草（L1019–1022)；融合第 1/4/末 AttnRes 块特征（L1023–1027)；直接优化接受率 LK loss "−log Σ min(p,q)"（式 16, L1028–1036)。

**B13. 长上下文数据合成** — §3.4, L891–894:
> "synthesize additional long-context data by carefully permuting and concatenating multimodal documents and sub-tasks, so that the embedded tasks can be solved only by attending to information scattered across the full 1M-token context"(L891–894)

### 总体判断

- **Kimi K3 弥补力最强的方向**(8–9成）：效率控制（#2)、MOPD warmup/师生分布对齐（#12)、MTP 草稿训练（#14)。这三项 K3 给出的是**结构性方法**而非数据补丁，尤其 #12 恰好是 Nemotron 自己点名未做的方案（L1537–1539)。
- **中等弥补（5–7成）**:agentic 环境类缺口（#3、#5、#6、#8、#9、#10)。K3 §4.2 的白盒 harness + 可验证任务族能把"数据商/内部工具/闭源 teacher 的 SFT 轨迹"转化为"自建环境 + RLVR"，路线更可持续，但极端难度校准（50–100 跳）、领域特化格式（CUDA 修复、上下文压缩行为）仍需自行补齐。
- **弥补力弱（≤3成）**:ACE-RTL(#4,K3 无 RTL 内容）与 MOPD 迭代共进化（#13,K3 无此机制）。
- 一个值得注意的非对称性：Nemotron 对**数据配比和规模**披露更细（如 STEM blend 精确到 token 数与百分比，L1413–1418),Kimi K3 对**环境与奖励机制**披露更细（correctness/performance 分段奖励、双 verifier、反 hack)。复现 Nemotron 未开源数据时，两者是互补而非替代关系——用 K3 的环境/任务合成框架，套 Nemotron 已公开的配比数字，是缺口清单上大多数项的最优组合路线。

**不确定性声明**:MiniMax 2.5、GLM 5.1、DeepSeek-V4-Pro 的开放程度按报告语境推断为闭源 API(L1396–1397 "model provider's recommended generation parameters" 暗示 API 调用）；若其中有开放权重版本，#3、#7 的评级可上调半档。"达成度几成"为基于原文覆盖度的工程判断，非实验验证值。

# Nemotron 3 Ultra 未开源后训练数据：公开替代方案调研报告

调研日期 2026-08-02。所有列出的链接均已实际打开验证（HF 数据集页面/API、GitHub 仓库、arXiv 摘要页）。license 只写我在页面上核实到的；未核实的标注"未标注"。

## 缺口 1：长上下文（128K–1M）合成 SFT 数据

- **ProLong**(Princeton)— https://github.com/princeton-nlp/ProLong ，数据 https://huggingface.co/datasets/princeton-nlp/prolong-data-64K 和 `prolong-data-512K`。已打包的 40B+40B token 64K/512K 续训数据 + UltraChat-64K SFT(1B token)，附完整过滤/打包/训练代码。论文 ACL 2025,license 未在页面直接标注（基于 Llama-3 需注意其许可）。
- **LongAlign-10k**(THUDM，现托管 zai-org)— https://huggingface.co/datasets/zai-org/LongAlign-10k 。1 万条 8K–64K 长指令 SFT 数据（多文档摘要/QA 等真实+人工构造），附 packing+sorted batching 训练代码。
- **LongWriter-6k** — https://huggingface.co/datasets/zai-org/LongWriter-6k 。6K 条超长输出（2K–32K 词）SFT 数据，AgentWrite 流水线合成，中英双语，补"长输出"维度。
- **NVIDIA RULER** — https://github.com/NVIDIA/RULER 。可配置长度/复杂度的合成任务生成器（多针检索、变量追踪、聚合、QA)，虽是评测设计但生成脚本可直接用来造 needle 类训练数据。

判断：**可用公开 pipeline 自己合成 + 部分直接下载**。ProLong/LongAlign 可直接用；128K–1M 的多文档推理数据需用 RULER 式生成器 + 长文语料（books/code repo）自行构造，无现成 1M 级 SFT 集。

## 缺口 2：推理效率控制（medium/low effort、预算截断）

- **s1 / s1K-1.1** — https://github.com/simplescaling/s1 ，数据 https://huggingface.co/datasets/simplescaling/s1K-1.1 。1K 样本 + budget forcing（思考预算截断/续写 "Wait"）的完整配方，另有 59K 消融数据 `simplescaling/data_ablation_full59K`。
- **L1 / LCPO**(CMU,COLM 2025)— https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.04697 。用 RL 训练"按 prompt 指定 token 数思考"的长度可控模型，代码与模型已在论文页面放出（仓库入口见 arXiv 页）。
- **AdaptThink**(THU-KEG,EMNLP 2025)— https://github.com/THU-KEG/AdaptThink 。RL 让模型按难度自选 Thinking/NoThinking，附训练代码与全部模型。
- **CoT-Valve** 数据 — https://huggingface.co/datasets/yiboowang/cot-valve (HF API 验证存在）。渐进式压缩 CoT 长度的训练数据。

判断：**可用公开 pipeline 自己合成**（无大规模现成 effort 分档数据集）。用 s1 的截断方法 + L1/AdaptThink 的 RL 配方，配合开源 teacher 采样不同长度轨迹即可自产。GPT-OSS/Qwen3 的 effort 接口是推理时行为，没有公开训练数据。

## 缺口 3：深度搜索 agent(50–100 跳、BrowseComp 难度）

## 二、Kimi K3 方法能弥补哪些

K3 §4.2 的白盒环境 + 可验证任务族，核心思路是**把"数据商/闭源 teacher 的 SFT 轨迹"转化为"自建环境 + RLVR"**。映射结果：

**弥补力最强（8–9 成）——K3 给的是结构性方法：**
- **效率控制**：K3 的 τ·b₀ 预算奖励课程（先大 τ 训 max 档再退火出 high/low)+ **回收各强度专家轨迹做 SFT** —— 正好替代 Nemotron 的 GPT-OSS medium-effort 样本，且更具体
- **MOPD warmup 缺口**：K3 的 9 个专家全部从**同一个 SFT 冷启动**经 RL 分化，从设计上消除了师生分布失配 —— 这正是 Nemotron 自己在 §3.3.5 点名"未及验证"的替代方案。warmup 补丁根本不再必需
- **MTP 草稿训练**:K3 的 EAGLE-3 式 LK loss（直接优化接受率）vs Nemotron 的温度 2 forward-KL，数据管线可互借

**中等弥补（5–7 成）——环境类缺口：**
- **CUDA(#5)**:K3 的 kernel 任务范式更完整 —— 数值超阈值零分、追平专家实现 0.5、逼近 roofline 趋 1、反 hack 检测（防 CUDA graph replay/input caching/降精度），覆盖 CUDA/Triton/CuTe 等 6 种 DSL
- **Office/GDPval(#8)**:K3 的 mock 应用（Gmail/Notion/Slack/Canvas，多日持久环境、数千次工具调用、逐事件评分）就是 AfterQuery 类任务的可自建替代
- **深度搜索（#3)**:K3 的知识图谱引导造题（agent 递归扩展 DAG + 网络检索素材）+ 可验证答案，摆脱数据商依赖；但 50–100 跳的极端难度校准机制 K3 也没给
- **上下文管理（#9)**:K3 把 context management 做成 harness 的可组合模块在 RL 中轮换，比 SFT 注入更抗过拟合

# deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash · Hugging Face

DeepSeek-V4: Towards Highly Efficient Million-Token Context Intelligence
	









    
  
  
    
  


    
  
  
    
  


    
  



  Technical Report👁️



	
		
	
	
		Introduction
	

We present a preview version of DeepSeek-V4 series, including two strong Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models — DeepSeek-V4-Pro with 1.6T parameters (49B activated) and DeepSeek-V4-Flash with 284B parameters (13B activated) — both supporting a context length of one million tokens.
DeepSeek-V4 series incorporate several key upgrades in architecture and optimization:

Hybrid Attention Architecture: We design a hybrid attention mechanism combining Compressed Sparse Attention (CSA) and Heavily Compressed Attention (HCA) to dramatically improve long-context efficiency. In the 1M-token context setting, DeepSeek-V4-Pro requires only 27% of single-token inference FLOPs and 10% of KV cache compared with DeepSeek-V3.2.
Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC): We incorporate mHC to strengthen conventional residual connections, enhancing stability of signal propagation across layers while preserving model expressivity.
Muon Optimizer: We employ the Muon optimizer for faster convergence and greater training stability.

We pre-train both models on more than 32T diverse and high-quality tokens, followed by a comprehensive post-training pipeline. The post-training features a two-stage paradigm: independent cultivation of domain-specific experts (through SFT and RL with GRPO), followed by unified model consolidation via on-policy distillation, integrating distinct proficiencies across diverse domains into a single model.
DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Max, the maximum reasoning effort mode of DeepSeek-V4-Pro, significantly advances the knowledge capabilities of open-source models, firmly establishing itself as the best open-source model available today. It achieves top-tier performance in coding benchmarks and significantly bridges the gap with leading closed-source models on reasoning and agentic tasks. Meanwhile, DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Max achieves comparable reasoning performance to the Pro version when given a larger thinking budget, though its smaller parameter scale naturally places it slightly behind on pure knowledge tasks and the most complex agentic workflows.

A brief example:

    {"role": "user", "content": "hello"},

		How to Run with vLLM
	

DSpark speculative decoding is enabled with a single flag — add --speculative-config with method: dspark to your vLLM launch command:
--speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":7,"draft_sample_method":"greedy"}'
For example, the command below serves the model with vLLM on a single 4×GB300 node. 
See the vLLM recipe for detailed instructions and other hardware configurations.
vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 \
  --trust-remote-code --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --block-size 256 \
  --data-parallel-size 4 --enable-expert-parallel \
  --moe-backend deep_gemm_mega_moe \
  --attention-config '{"use_fp4_indexer_cache": true}' \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":7,"draft_sample_method":"greedy"}'


	
		
	
	
		How to Run with SGLang
	

Enable DSpark with --speculative-algorithm DSPARK and do not set a separate --speculative-draft-model-path as the target and draft weights therefore come from the same checkpoint.
See the SGLang cookbook for detailed instructions, benchmarks and other hardwares configurations.

  --trust-remote-code \
  --model-path deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 \
  --tp 4 \
  --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_mxfp4 \

### 2.3 RL:3 领域 × 3 推理强度 = 9 个专家(§4.1.2、§4.2)
- 领域:general tasks / general agents / coding agents;强度:{low, high, max}。
- 算法沿用 K2.5(未点名 GRPO/PPO):**per-token 正则**约束局部更新,容忍 **partial rollout**(完成比例 λ 即暂停生成,下轮优先恢复;microVM 沙箱)。
- **Reasoning effort RL**:初始预算 b₀(x)(cold-start 模型估计),超 τ·b₀ 的轨迹 reward 覆写 −1;先大 τ 训 max 档,退火 τ 得 high/low 档。
- Reward:可验证任务用规则 verifier;不可验证用 **Agentic GRM**(锦标赛式二元比较;judge 强制 rubric 协议;超 σ·ℓ₀ 长度自动判负防啰嗦 hacking)。
- 环境族(§4.2):统一白盒 harness(模块:工具接口/系统提示/上下文管理/skills/记忆/子 agent;可实例化 Kimi Code/Claude Code/Codex/OpenClaw/Hermes);知识图谱引导任务合成(agent 递归扩展 DAG + 网络检索素材);可验证 agentic 任务;kernel 优化(CUDA/Triton/CuTe/Gluon/ThunderKittens/TileLang,正确性阈值零分、追平专家实现 0.5、逼近 roofline 趋 1,反 hack 检测);mock 个人助理应用(Gmail/Notion/Slack/Canvas,数千次工具调用);双 verifier 的 Autonomous Execution Tasks;Web 开发。

### 2.4 MOPD(§4.1.3)
- 按 (domain, effort) 路由到 9 个教师;**不用 KL loss,把逐 token log 比率奖励嵌入 RL 框架**:
  `r_t = clip(sg[log(π_teacher(y_t|·) / π_θ(y_t|·))], −R_max, R_max)`,在学生自身 rollout 上计算 dense reward。
- 与 partial rollout 等 RL 基建无缝兼容;top-k 细粒度蒸馏目标无明确收益。
- 引用:Thinking Machines on-policy distillation、MiMo-V2-Flash、DeepSeek-V4。

### 2.5 EAGLE-3 draft 微调(§4.1.4)
- MTP 层 → EAGLE-3 式 draft;target 冻结,只训 draft 层 + 特征融合投影;7 步展开;融合第 1/4/末 AttnRes block 特征;直接优化接受率 LK loss `L = −log Σ min(p,q)`。

### 2.6 开源情况
- **仅权重**(HF `moonshotai/Kimi-K3`)+ 基础设施(MoonEP、AgentENV、MiniTriton、nano-kpu)。后训练代码/数据均未开源;训练量、超参几乎全未披露。

---

## 3. Nemotron 3 Ultra 后训练(§3)

**Pipeline:Base → SFT → RLVR → MOPD Warmup → MOPD ×2 轮 → MTP Boosting → Final。**

### 3.1 SFT(两阶段,配置全披露)
- Stage 1:pack 288K,GBS 64,204,800 samples,LR 峰值 1.5e-5→1e-6;Stage 2:pack 515K,19,200 samples,LR 峰值 1e-5;保留 MTP 辅助 loss 0.1。
- 数据(§3.1.1):512K 长上下文合成;GPT-OSS-120B medium-effort 样本 + 预算截断轨迹(`</think>` 屏蔽 loss);安全 135K 六语种;搜索(OpenResearcher 21.7K 等);终端 ~370K;数学/证明 1.8M 工具 + 1.9M 非工具(Nemotron-Cascade-2);代码 1.2M Py + 1.0M C++ + 1.3M 工具调用;CUDA ~100K;RTL ~1.2M(ACE-RTL);多语言等。

### 3.2 RLVR(统一混合环境 GRPO)
- 异步 GRPO;15 类环境(terminal/SWE/搜索/数学/代码/安全/聊天/IF/长上下文 QA/结构化输出/可用性等);每类任务至少 2 种 harness。
- GBS 8192 = 512 prompt × 16 rollouts;生成长度 48K→64K;~2.5% medium-effort 提示 + 长度 reward 调整(最终省 ~2.5× token,精度降 ~7%)。LR/clip 报告未披露,但 NeMo RL YAML 有(advantage clip ±20)。

### 3.3 MOPD(核心,2 轮迭代)
- 目标:学生在自身 prefix 上逐 token 最小化对教师的 reverse KL;异步三路流水(rollout/teacher 打分/learner);行为策略与信任域中心解耦;PPO 式 clip;token mask 用 IcePop。
- 配置:最大生成 192K;每 batch 1024 prompt × 1 rollout(多 rollout 无收益)。
- 教师 panel:Iteration 1 = STEM、Chat、IF、Terminal、工具调用、SWE、Search、Office、Usability、Agentic Safety(+ RLVR Student 自教);Iteration 2 新分化 Chat 2/Coding/Conv tool-use 2/SWE 2/Office work 2 → Ultra Final。
- **MOPD Warmup 关键发现**:pipeline 差异大的教师直接合并效果差(学生轨迹对教师 OOD);先做极轻 SFT 对齐分布(GDPVal 恢复 46.7 vs 35.3)。
- Recovery 普遍 67%–172%;HLE 仅 16.9%(教师优势来自离线数据,on-policy 信号覆盖不到)。

### 3.4 MTP Boosting
- backbone 冻结只训共享 MTP 头;第 k 步输入从 1..k−1 步 hidden states 采样(模拟推理噪声);温度 2 forward-KL 蒸馏(禁 gold CE);12K 步、GBS 64、8K 上限。接受长度 4.387→4.584;RL rollout 生成 1.46× 加速。

### 3.5 量化:纯 PTQ,无 QAT
- Model-Optimizer 量化到 NVFP4:routed expert GEMM NVFP4,shared expert/Mamba linear FP8,attention/latent/embedding/MTP 保 BF16;KV cache FP8。5.03 BPE;单 checkpoint 同服 Blackwell(W4A4)与 Hopper(W4A16)。BF16 vs NVFP4 基本无损。

### 3.6 开源情况
- Checkpoint:NVFP4 / BF16 / Base BF16 / GenRM 全开放。
- 数据:49 个数据集的 HF Collection + `Nemotron-RL-Ultra-Training-Blends`(7 blends,337,721 行)。
- 代码:NeMo RL ultra-v3 分支(完整 RL 指南 + 每阶段 YAML)、Nemotron ultra3 recipe(pretrain+SFT)。
- 限制:两轮 MOPD 的中间 teacher/MOPD1 checkpoint 未发布,完整两轮不可 1:1 复现;SWE .sif 镜像需自建。

---

## 4. 两者对比与结论

| 维度 | Kimi K3 | Nemotron 3 Ultra |
|---|---|---|
| 量化策略 | **QAT 贯穿 SFT+RL**(MXFP4 权重 + MXFP8 激活,仅 MoE expert) | NVFP4 预训练 + 后训练 BF16 + 最终 **PTQ**(无 QAT) |
| RL 组织 | 3 域 × 3 强度 = 9 专家并行 | 统一混合 RLVR Student → 10+ 专门 teacher |
| MOPD 形式 | log 比率 dense reward 嵌入 RL 循环 | reverse KL + PPO clip,异步三路流水,2 轮迭代 + Warmup |
| 推理强度 | RL 直接训 low/high/max 三档专家 | SFT 初始化 medium-effort + RLVR 长度 reward |
| 投机解码 | EAGLE-3(LK loss) | MTP Boosting(T=2 forward-KL) |
| 披露风格 | 环境/奖励机制细 | 数据配比/规模细 |
| 复现可行性 | 仅权重 | 数据/代码/配置/judge 全开,但需 GB200 集群 |

**核心共识**:两者同属一个范式 ——「先 RL 出一组专门化教师,再 on-policy 蒸馏合并回单一学生」+ 稀疏大 MoE + MTP + FP4 的效率底座。DeepSeek-V4 官方后训练(见 03 文档)也是同一范式(领域专家 SFT+GRPO → on-policy distillation 合并),说明该范式已是 2026 年 frontier 模型后训练的事实标准。

**关键差异点(借鉴优先级)**:
1. K3 的 9 专家共享同一 SFT 冷启动 → 天然消除师生分布失配,免掉 MOPD Warmup(Nemotron 自己点名未及验证的方案)。
2. K3 把蒸馏做成 RL dense reward,可复用 partial rollout 等全套 RL 基建。
3. K3 全程 QAT 适合"最终交付 FP4 模型"的场景;NVIDIA 的"BF16 后训练 + 末端 PTQ"工程更简单,且他们证明 NVFP4 PTQ 基本无损 —— 对 V4-Flash(官方已是 FP4+FP8)而言,**建议走 NVIDIA 路线(BF16/FP8 后训练 + PTQ 验证),QAT 仅在 PTQ 掉点时再上**。
"}

> 日期:2026-08-02。配套代码在 `pipelines/`,试点种子数据在 `seeds/`(由 Kimi 作为 teacher 直接合成)。

## 0. 目标与基线

- **学生模型**:[DeepSeek-V4-Flash](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash),284B 总参 / 13B 激活 MoE,1M 上下文,FP4+FP8 混合精度,MIT license(可自由蒸馏/再训练)。
- **目标参照**:[DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731),官方重新后训练版,agentic 大幅提升:Terminal Bench 2.1 82.7 / NL2Repo 54.2 / Cybergym 76.7 / DeepSWE 54.4 / Toolathlon-Verified 70.3 / Agents' Last Exam 25.2 / AutomationBench 25.1。
- **官方范式**(V4 技术报告):两阶段 —— 领域专家独立培养(SFT + GRPO RL)→ on-policy distillation 合并。与 Kimi K3 / Nemotron 3 Ultra 的 MOPD 范式相同,我们的方案直接对齐这一结构。
- **0731 特有**:DSpark 投机解码模块(vLLM `--speculative-config method:dspark`)。若需要,最后用 MTP/draft 蒸馏补(对应 K3 EAGLE-3 / Ultra MTP Boosting 方法)。

**硬件现状**:本节点 3× H200(141GB,CUDA 13.0),/home 19TB 空闲(Weka 共享盘)。vLLM 官方 recipe 显示 V4-Flash-0731 可在**单个 4×GB300 节点**服务;在 3×H200 上可用 TP=3 + FP4 权重服务(权重约 150–190GB,可行但紧张;KV cache 用 FP8,长上下文 rollout 需控制并发)。更大规模 rollout 需要集群节点。

## 1. 总体路线图

```
Stage 0  冷启动 SFT 数据合成(本文档 5 条 pipeline + 已开源数据)
Stage 1  SFT:DeepSeek-V4-Flash + 合成数据混合(对齐官方 SFT 格式,encoding_dsv4 chat 模板)
Stage 2  分领域 GRPO RLVR:5 个领域专家(必要时 × low/high/max 3 档强度)
Stage 3  MOPD:以 Stage 2 专家为 teacher panel,on-policy 蒸馏回单一模型
         (推荐 K3 变体:专家共享同一 SFT 冷启动 → 免 MOPD Warmup)
Stage 4  (可选)DSpark/MTP draft 蒸馏;PTQ 到 FP4 并回归验证
```

**Teacher 策略**(三档,按成本):
- **T0(零成本,现在就能跑)**:Kimi(本 agent)作为 seed teacher —— 已在 `seeds/` 产出各领域种子样本与 pipeline 自举 prompt。用于冷启动 prompt 池和 few-shot 示例。
- **T1(本地,自举)**:vLLM 在 3×H200 上服务 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 自身做 rejection sampling(self-improvement / on-policy)。1× H200 可同时服务 gpt-oss-120b(MXFP4)做 judge/备选 teacher。
- **T2(API/集群)**:DeepSeek API(V4-Pro)、Qwen3-Coder-480B 等作为更强 teacher;在集群上批量 rollout。

**统一数据 schema**(见 `pipelines/common/schema.py`):
- SFT 样本:`{id, domain, task_type, messages[], meta{}, verification{}}`
- RL prompt:`{id, domain, messages[], reward{type, config}, meta{}}`
- reward.type ∈ `code_exec | kernel_bench | iverilog | search_verify | rubric | rule`

---

## 2. Pipeline A:CUDA kernel 生成/修复/优化

**目标**:复刻 Nemotron CUDA 100K(生成/修复/优化三类)+ Kimi K3 kernel RL 奖励。
**判定:可直接下载替代(部分)+ 自行放大。**

### 2.1 数据源(种子)
- 直接下载:[Sakana AI-CUDA-Engineer-Archive](https://huggingface.co/datasets/SakanaAI/AI-CUDA-Engineer-Archive)(带编译/正确性/speedup/profiling 元数据的 PyTorch→CUDA kernel 对)、[GPUMODE/KernelBook](https://huggingface.co/datasets/GPUMODE/KernelBook)(真实项目 PyTorch↔Triton 对)、[KernelBench](https://github.com/ScalingIntelligence/KernelBench)(250+ 任务 + 评测 harness,MIT)。
- 自造种子:从 PyTorch OpInfo / timm / transformers / vLLM 的 eager 算子片段抽取 reference(与 BackendBench 同思路)。

### 2.2 合成流程(`pipelines/cuda_kernel/`)
1. **任务生成**:teacher 按模板产出 `{pytorch_reference, 随机输入生成器, 数值容差}`;或用现成 KernelBench 任务。
2. **候选生成**:teacher 生成 CUDA/Triton/CuTe 实现(rejection sampling,k=8–16;Triton 优先 —— 本机无 nvcc,但 Triton 自带 JIT,3×H200 可直接验证)。
3. **三级验证**(`verifier.py`):
   - 编译失败 → reward 0;
   - 数值误差超阈值(rtol/atol 按 dtype 表)→ reward 0;
   - 正确则 benchmark(triton.testing.do_bench),`reward = 0.5 + 0.5 * clip(log(speedup)/log(target_speedup))` —— 对齐 K3:追平专家实现 0.5,逼近 roofline 趋 1。
4. **反 hack**(对齐 K3):静态检查禁用 CUDA graph replay、输入缓存、降精度;随机换输入形状复测。
5. **修复类数据**:对失败候选,把 `{错误信息(compiler/assert), 候选代码}` 拼成修复 prompt,teacher 产出修正版 → (buggy, error, fixed) 三元组 SFT 样本。
6. **优化类数据**:以已通过 kernel 为新 reference,迭代挑战更高 speedup(hill-climbing),每轮保留改进轨迹 → 多轮优化 SFT/RL 样本。

### 2.3 产出与成本
- SFT JSONL:生成(参考+实现+思考轨迹)、修复(三元组)、优化(多轮轨迹)三类。
- RL prompt JSONL:`reward.type=kernel_bench`,config 指向 reference/容差/目标 speedup。
- 成本:单条验证 ~秒级(Triton JIT);100K 规模 ≈ 3×H200 数天(验证不是瓶颈,teacher rollout 才是)。

---

## 3. Pipeline B:长上下文(128K–1M)SFT 数据

**目标**:复刻 Ultra 512K 合成(多文档推理/顺序扫描/合成表格)+ K3 的"全上下文散布信息"原则。
**判定:64K–512K 有现成(ProLong/LongAlign),1M 级必须自合成。**

### 3.1 直接下载
- [princeton-nlp/prolong-data-512K](https://huggingface.co/datasets/princeton-nlp/prolong-data-512K)(40B token 续训 + SFT)、[zai-org/LongAlign-10k](https://huggingface.co/datasets/zai-org/LongAlign-10k)、[LongWriter-6k](https://huggingface.co/datasets/zai-org/LongWriter-6k)(长输出)。

### 3.2 自合成流程(`pipelines/long_context/`)
三类任务生成器(对齐 Ultra §3.1.1 + K3 §3.4):
1. **多文档推理**:从长文语料(books、代码仓库、arXiv、法律/财报)采 2–8 篇文档,teacher 生成"必须跨 ≥2 篇文档的事实链"问题 + 答案 + 证据指针;负样本混入无关文档(distractor)。
2. **顺序扫描 / needle**:RULER 式程序化生成(多针检索、变量追踪、聚合、频次统计)—— 全程序合成,不需要 teacher,可无限量;用 [NVIDIA/RULER](https://github.com/NVIDIA/RULER) 的生成脚本改造。
3. **合成表格查询**:程序生成大 CSV/JSON 表格(数万行)嵌入上下文,生成聚合/过滤/join 类问题,答案由 pandas 执行 SQL 等效查询得到(自动可验证)。
4. **K3 原则校验**:每个样本做 leave-one-out 检测 —— 去掉任一关键文档后问题不可答,否则丢弃(保证"必须读全上下文")。
5. 长度分桶:32K / 128K / 512K / 1M 四档,配比建议对齐 Ultra LC 阶段(92% 长 + 8% 4K 数学/代码);V4-Flash 原生 1M,直接覆盖全档。
6. 回答由 teacher 在**看到全文**下生成,再做一致性检查(judge 或答案匹配)。

### 3.3 产出与成本
- SFT JSONL(含证据指针 meta);RL prompt 用 needle/表格类(规则可验证)。
- 成本:needle/表格近零成本;多文档推理主要成本在 teacher 读长文(1M token 级 prompt),建议 T2 或集群批量。

---

## 4. Pipeline C:深度搜索 agent(50–100 跳)

**目标**:替代数据商定制难样本 + Ultra Search teacher 上下文管理数据。
**判定:pipeline 成熟但重资产;用 K3 的 KG 造题 + Tongyi/ASearcher 的开源实现。**

### 4.1 任务合成(造题,`pipelines/deep_search/task_gen.py`)
两条路线并用:
1. **K3 知识图谱法**:agent 递归扩展概念 DAG(每个节点多次网络检索,识别等价/相关概念复用节点,原子化即止);采样节点 + 祖先上下文组合成检索查询,抓取真实素材,由合成 agent 产出"多跳、答案唯一可验证"的问题。
2. **WebShaper 形式化法**([Alibaba-NLP/WebShaper](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Alibaba-NLP/WebShaper)):用集合操作(IS/交并差)形式化描述实体链,从 Wikipedia 出发逐层"混淆化"扩展(多实体、属性约束),天然控制跳数与难度 —— 这是公开方法里最接近 BrowseComp 难度分布的。
- 答案验证:问题必须带程序化可判定的短答案(实体名/日期/数值),由第二个独立 agent 走不同检索路径复核,双路一致才入库。

### 4.2 轨迹采集(rollout)
- Harness:复刻 Ultra 附录 A 的 BrowseComp harness(Tavily/自建 SearXNG 搜索 + 网页浏览 + terminal,结果持久化到 per-task 工作区,用 grep/head/sed 查看)。
- 直接用开源实现:[Tongyi DeepResearch](https://github.com/Alibaba-NLP/DeepResearch)(含 WebDancer/WebSailor/WebShaper/ReSum 全家桶,Apache-2.0)、[ASearcher](https://github.com/inclusionAI/ASearcher)(全异步 agentic RL,轨迹超 100 轮)。
- Teacher rollout 成功轨迹 → SFT;全部轨迹(含失败) → RL prompt + 规则 reward(答案匹配)。

### 4.3 上下文管理数据(Ultra Search teacher 缺口)
- 在 harness 中实现 **discard-all 重置** 与 **摘要压缩** 两种策略(Ultra §3.3.2),同一任务各跑一份轨迹;
- 或用 [ReSum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.13313)(周期摘要 + GRPO advantage broadcasting,仅 1K 样本即接近 SOTA)与 [MemAgent](https://github.com/BytedTsinghua-SIA/MemAgent)(RL 训练记忆覆写,8K→3.5M 外推);
- K3 替代思路:把上下文管理做成 harness 可组合模块,RL 中直接暴露多策略 —— 更抗过拟合。

### 4.4 成本
- 搜索 API(Tavily 或自建 SearXNG+Common Crawl 索引,对齐 OpenResearcher 的 15M FineWeb 本地索引做法);50–100 跳轨迹单条约 0.5–2M token,是五条 pipeline 里单样本最贵的,建议先做 5–10K 高质量题 + RL 放大,而非堆 SFT 量。

---

## 5. Pipeline D:RTL / Verilog(百万级)

**目标**:复刻 ACE-RTL ~1.2M(spec→RTL 生成 / 编辑 / 调试)。
**判定:无公开大规模数据,必须自建;但方法公开(CodeV 摘要反演 + ACE-RTL 骨架)。**

### 5.1 种子语料
- 抓 license 干净的 RTL 仓库(OpenCores、GitHub MIT/Apache/BSD 硬件项目、PULP、OpenTitan、Rocket、CV32E 等);参考 [VeriGen/VGen](https://github.com/shailja-thakur/VGen) 的抓取清单与 [CodeV](https://github.com/IPRC-DIP/CodeV) 的多级摘要法。注意:ScaleRTL 无公开 artifact,需自己重做其"license-checked RTL 仓库集"。

### 5.2 三类任务合成(`pipelines/rtl/`)
1. **spec→RTL 生成**(对齐 CodeV):teacher 为真实 RTL 模块生成多级自然语言 spec(接口级 → 行为级 → 微架构级);训练样本 = (spec, RTL) 对,方向反转使用。
2. **编辑**:对模块做语义保持变换(重命名、流水化、位宽参数化)或功能变更,teacher 生成编辑指令 + 修改后代码。
3. **调试**:程序注入真实设计错误(少驱动/多驱动、位宽截断、组合环、复位缺失、FSM 转移错误、握手违例),teacher 看 spec + buggy 代码 + 仿真报错 → 定位并修复,产出 (buggy, error_log, fixed, 解释) 四元组。
4. **验证**(双保险):
   - 语法/编译:iverilog / verilator(集群节点装,或容器 `hdltools` 镜像);本机先用 pyverilog 做 parser 级检查;
   - 功能:teacher 同时生成 testbench + 参考模型(直接来自原模块),注入错误后必须 fail、修复后必须 pass —— 自对赌(self-consistency),无需人工。
5. **去污**:与 RTLLM/VerilogEval 题集做 n-gram 重叠检测。

### 5.3 规模与成本
- 百万级路径:10–20 万真实模块 × 多级 spec(3 级)× 任务类型(3 类)即达 ~1M;错误注入是纯程序的,边际成本近零;主要成本是 teacher 写 spec/testbench 与仿真算力(CPU 即可,iverilog 很快)。

---

## 6. Pipeline E:Office / GDPval 类交付物任务

**目标**:替代 AfterQuery rollout(完全未公开)—— 性价比最低但 0731 的 AutomationBench/GDPval 维度需要。
**判定:公开的全是评测环境;用 K3 mock 应用法自建环境 + rollout。**

### 6.1 环境(`pipelines/office/`)
- 现成环境:[OSWorld](https://github.com/xlang-ai/OSWorld)(369+ 真实 Ubuntu 任务,LibreOffice/GIMP/浏览器,可执行评测)、[OfficeBench](https://github.com/zlwang-cs/OfficeBench)(300 跨应用任务)、[SpreadsheetBench](https://github.com/RUCKBReasoning/SpreadsheetBench)(912 真实 Excel 问题 + OJ 式测试)、[openai/gdpval](https://huggingface.co/datasets/openai/gdpval)(220 题金标子集,含参考文件与逐条 rubric —— 是定义任务分布和评分标准的最佳参照)。
- **K3 mock 应用法(主力)**:实现 Gmail/Notion/Slack/日历/文件系统的 mock 服务(REST + 持久化 state),按"多日剧本"注入事件流;每个事件携带**确定性评分规则**(状态断言)或 LLM rubric —— 与 K3 §4.2.5 一致。初始工作区由 agent 检索公开素材搭建。

### 6.2 任务与轨迹
1. 任务合成:以 gdpval 的 44 职业/9 行业分类为骨架,teacher 生成任务卡(角色、背景文件集、交付物要求、rubric);交付物类型覆盖文档/表格/幻灯片/邮件流/数据分析。
2. 轻量起步:优先做"文档/表格 + 文件操作"类(可用 LibreOffice headless + openpyxl/python-docx 程序化校验),PPT 美化类放最后(只能 judge 评分)。
3. 轨迹采集:strong teacher 在 harness 中 rollout(轻 SFT 预热 → pivot RL,Ultra §3.3.2 的 AfterQuery 配方);评分 = 程序化状态断言 + rubric judge 混合。
4. RL reward:`rule`(状态断言)+ `rubric`(judge 按任务卡 rubric 打分),造假/空交付直接零分(对齐 K3 Web 任务做法)。

### 6.3 成本
- mock 应用开发是一次性工程(1–2 周级);轨迹成本与深度搜索相当;建议规模 20–50K 任务卡,RL 为主、SFT 仅冷启动。

---

## 7. 五条 pipeline 优先级(按性价比)

| 序 | Pipeline | 理由 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | CUDA kernel | 数万条现成直下;验证基建本机可跑;K3 奖励公式现成 |
| 2 | 长上下文 | needle/表格近零成本;ProLong/LongAlign 直接补 |
| 3 | RTL | 错误注入自对赌几乎零边际成本;无公开替代,做了就是独占 |
| 4 | 深度搜索 | 提升 BrowseComp 最直接,但重资产(搜索 API + 异步 RL) |
| 5 | Office/GDPval | 最复杂,环境工程大;但 0731 目标维度里 AutomationBench/GDPval 绕不开 |

## 8. 与 Kimi K3 方法的映射(弥补力评估)

- **8–9 成弥补**:效率控制(τ·b₀ 预算课程 + 专家轨迹回收)、MOPD warmup(9 专家同源冷启动,结构性消除)、MTP/draft(EAGLE-3 LK loss)。
- **5–7 成**:CUDA(kernel 分段奖励 + 反 hack)、Office(mock 应用 + 逐事件评分)、深度搜索(KG 造题 + 可验证答案)、工具调用轨迹、上下文管理、长时程终端。
- **≤3 成**:RTL(K3 无 EDA 内容,靠 ACE-RTL/CodeV 路线)、MOPD 迭代共进化(K3 无此机制)。
- **互补原则**:K3 给环境/奖励机制,Ultra 给配比/规模数字;本方案 = K3 的环境框架 × Ultra 的配比 × 上表开源资源。

## 9. 立即执行清单

1. `pipelines/` 各目录脚手架已由 coder 子代理实现(见 README 状态表)。
2. `seeds/` 试点批次:Kimi 作为 teacher 直接合成的每领域样本(JSONL),含 RTL(T-pyverilog 语法验证)与 Triton kernel(H200 上数值验证)的实测结果。
3. 下一步(需要你决策):是否在本机起 vLLM 服务 V4-Flash 做 T1 自举 rollout;搜索 API key(Tavily)或自建 SearXNG;集群节点安装 iverilog/verilator 的容器方案。

{"content": """"Teacher client: OpenAI-compatible wrapper for synthesis rollouts.

Configuration via env vars:
  TEACHER_BASE_URL   e.g. http://localhost:8000/v1  (local vLLM) or an API endpoint
  TEACHER_API_KEY    default "EMPTY" for local vLLM
  TEACHER_MODEL      e.g. deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash | openai/gpt-oss-120b | ...

Local serving options (3x H200 node):
  # Self-teacher (T1): V4-Flash FP4, TP=3, FP8 KV cache
  vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash --trust-remote-code \
    --tensor-parallel-size 3 --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --max-model-len 262144
  # Judge / alternative teacher on a spare GPU: gpt-oss-120b (MXFP4, single H200)

DeepSeek-V4 note: the repo ships an `encoding/` folder (encode_messages) instead of
a Jinja chat template; vLLM >= the version with dsv4 support handles this natively.
Recommended sampling: temperature=1.0 (top_p=0.95 for agentic, 1.0 otherwise).

Uses only the stdlib + `urllib` so pipelines have zero hard deps; if the `openai`
package is available it is used instead.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import time
import urllib.request
from typing import Any

BASE_URL = os.environ.get("TEACHER_BASE_URL", "http://localhost:8000/v1")
API_KEY = os.environ.get("TEACHER_API_KEY", "EMPTY")
MODEL = os.environ.get("TEACHER_MODEL", "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash")


def chat(
    messages: list[dict[str, str]],
    *,
    model: str | None = None,
    temperature: float = 1.0,
    top_p: float = 1.0,
    max_tokens: int = 8192,
    n: int = 1,
    extra: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    retries: int = 3,
    backoff: float = 2.0,
) -> list[str]:
    """Return n completion texts. Retries with exponential backoff."""
    payload: dict[str, Any] = {
        "model": model or MODEL,
        "messages": messages,
        "temperature": temperature,
        "top_p": top_p,
        "max_tokens": max_tokens,
        "n": n,
    }
    if extra:
        payload.update(extra)
    last_err: Exception | None = None
    for attempt in range(retries):
        try:
            return _post_chat(payload)
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            last_err = e
            if attempt < retries - 1:
                time.sleep(backoff * (2**attempt))
    raise RuntimeError(f"teacher chat failed after {retries} tries: {last_err}")


def _post_chat(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        f"{BASE_URL.rstrip('/')}/chat/completions",
        data=json.dumps(payload).encode(),
        headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}",
        },
        method="POST",
    )

- `tasks.py` — 8 个内置种子任务（fused_softmax / rmsnorm / layer_norm / matmul_gelu / rotary_embedding / swiglu / simplified_attention / transpose_scale)，每个含 `pytorch_reference`、`input_gen`(seed 决定形状，支持换形复测）、`rtol/atol`、`target_speedup`、难度标签、`known_good_triton` + `known_buggy_triton`（自验证与 dry-run mock 用）;`KernelTask.from_kernelbench()` 预留 KernelBench 导入接口（不下载）;`reward_from_speedup()` 实现 §2.2 奖励公式

- `out_dryrun/` — 实测产出（16 SFT + 8 RL)

**交付物 B:`pipelines/rtl/`**
- `seed_modules/` — `sync_fifo.v` / `round_robin_arbiter.v` / `axis_skid_buffer.v`（合法可综合 Verilog-2001，统一 reset/case 风格供模式匹配）+ `tb/` 下 3 个自检查 testbench（打印 TEST PASSED/FAILED)
- `mutate.py` — 6 类注入：位宽截断、时序块阻塞赋值误用、case 缺 default(latch)、复位缺失、敏感列表缺信号、端口位宽不匹配；每类带 error 描述；全部保持语法合法（功能 bug)
- `verify.py` — L0 pyverilog 解析（用 `VerilogParser.parse(text)` 绕开 `iverilog -E` 预处理）;L1 iverilog+vvp 编译仿真，无工具时标 `iverilog_missing` 跳过；`self_consistency()` 自对赌（原模块 pass、注入后 fail)

## 实测结果（关键日志）

verifier 自验证 8/8 通过（H200,`do_bench` 实测）:
```
fused_softmax        speedup=1.29  reward=0.82  max_err=7.5e-09
rmsnorm              speedup=3.79  reward=1.00  max_err=1.9e-06
layer_norm           speedup=1.68  reward=1.00  max_err=2.4e-06
matmul_gelu          speedup=1.13  reward=0.83  max_err=3.9e-03
rotary_embedding     speedup=4.46  reward=1.00  max_err=9.5e-07
swiglu               speedup=1.47  reward=0.97  max_err=1.9e-06
simplified_attention speedup=9.03  reward=1.00  max_err=2.0e-03
transpose_scale      speedup=1.93  reward=1.00  max_err=0.0
```

```
[PASS] fused_softmax cand0: speedup=1.250 reward=0.775
[FAIL] fused_softmax cand1: [correctness] numerical mismatch ... max_abs_err=4.202e-01
[REPAIRED] fused_softmax cand1: speedup=1.180
... "sft_samples": 16, "rl_prompts": 8
```

RTL：三个种子模块 L0 全过；14 个注入（fifo/skid 各 4 类、arbiter 6 类）全部按预期（语法合法的功能 bug,L0 通过）;dry-run 产出 23 SFT(9 generation + 14 debug)+ 17 RL，全部过 `validate_file`,L1 正确标注 `iverilog_missing`。

开发中修掉的两个真 bug:① triton 3.7 无 `tl.math.tanh`，改手写 `1-2/(exp(2t)+1)`;② attention 的 mock buggy 替换字符串不匹配导致 buggy==good 静默失效，已修并在 `tasks.py` 加了模块级断言防复发。

- **无 nvcc**:CUDA C++ 候选无法编译验证，verifier 当前只支持 Triton 候选（与方案 §2.2 "Triton 优先"一致）；静态检查对 CUDA 源码仍有价值但未启用

3. verifier 支持 `--device cuda:N`，可按 GPU 数并行多个 synthesize 进程分片任务；RTL 侧纯 CPU，可直接大规模跑种子语料（方案 §5.1 的 OpenCores/PULP 抓取清单接入 `synthesize.py --modules-dir` 即可）

{"content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Pilot seed batch synthesized by Kimi (acting as seed teacher, tier T0).

Produces seeds/{cuda_kernel,rtl,long_context,deep_search,office}_seeds.jsonl
conforming to pipelines/common/schema.py. Every sample carries a `verification`
block; CUDA/Triton and RTL samples are machine-checked by verify_seeds.py.

Usage:
  python3 seeds/make_seeds.py            # writes all seed JSONL files
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from pipelines.common.schema import SFTSample, write_jsonl  # noqa: E402

OUT = ROOT / "seeds"
TEACHER = "kimi-k3 (agent, T0 seed teacher)"
DATE = "2026-08-02"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- cuda_kernel

CUDA_TASK_1_USER = """You are given a PyTorch reference operator. Write a fused Triton kernel that matches it numerically and beats it on an NVIDIA H200 (bf16 inputs).

Reference:
```python
import torch

def reference(x: torch.Tensor, res: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    # fused SiLU activation + residual add
    return x * torch.sigmoid(x) + res
```

Inputs: `x`, `res` are contiguous 1-D bf16 tensors of length n (n up to 64 Mi, not necessarily a multiple of the block size).
Requirements: single kernel launch, out-of-place into `out`, handle the tail with masks. Return the Python launch wrapper `silu_residual(x, res)`.
Numerical tolerance: rtol=2e-2, atol=2e-2 (bf16). Target speedup vs reference: 1.3x (the reference is already one fused torch.compile-free expression, so wins come from one-pass memory traffic)."""

CUDA_TASK_1_ASSISTANT = """Analysis: the reference computes silu(x)+res with three separate reads (sigmoid kernel, mul kernel, add kernel) if unfused; even fused by torch inductor it is memory-bound at 3 tensors * 2 bytes. A single Triton pass reads x and res once and writes out once — minimal traffic, so the kernel should be bandwidth-limited and beat a non-fused chain.

Design: 1-D grid, BLOCK=1024 elements per program, masked tail. bf16 loads are auto-promoted to fp32 for the sigmoid to keep accuracy, store back as bf16.

```python
import torch
import triton
import triton.language as tl


@triton.jit
def _silu_residual_kernel(x_ptr, res_ptr, out_ptr, n, BLOCK: tl.constexpr):
    pid = tl.program_id(0)
    offs = pid * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
    mask = offs < n
    x = tl.load(x_ptr + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
    r = tl.load(res_ptr + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
    y = x * tl.sigmoid(x) + r
    tl.store(out_ptr + offs, y.to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty), mask=mask)


def silu_residual(x: torch.Tensor, res: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    assert x.is_contiguous() and res.is_contiguous() and x.shape == res.shape
    out = torch.empty_like(x)
    n = x.numel()
    BLOCK = 1024
    grid = (triton.cdiv(n, BLOCK),)
    _silu_residual_kernel[grid](x, res, out, n, BLOCK=BLOCK, num_warps=4)
    return out
```
"""

CUDA_TASK_2_USER = """Write a Triton kernel for causal-masked softmax over the last dim of a square matrix.

Reference:
```python
import torch

def reference(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    # x: [N, N] fp32, row i attends to columns 0..i
    N = x.shape[0]
    causal = torch.tril(torch.ones(N, N, dtype=torch.bool, device=x.device))
    return torch.softmax(x.masked_fill(~causal, float("-inf")), dim=-1)
```

x is [N, N] fp32 contiguous, N in [1, 4096] (not necessarily a power of two). One program per row. Tolerance rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-5. Target speedup 1.5x vs reference."""

CUDA_TASK_2_ASSISTANT = """Analysis: torch's masked_fill + softmax does two full passes over the matrix plus a materialized mask. A single-pass online-softmax is unnecessary here because one row (<=4096 floats) fits in registers; a one-program-per-row kernel with a padded BLOCK_N does one load, one max, one exp/sum, one store.

Edge cases: (1) rows are never empty because column 0 is always visible; (2) masked-out lanes must contribute exp(-inf)=0, so `other=-inf` on load and an explicit `cols <= row` where-clause; (3) N not a power of two -> BLOCK_N = next_power_of_2(N), guarded by `cols < N`.

```python
import torch
import triton
import triton.language as tl


@triton.jit
def _causal_softmax_kernel(x_ptr, out_ptr, N, BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr):
    row = tl.program_id(0)
    cols = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)
    in_range = cols < N
    x = tl.load(x_ptr + row * N + cols, mask=in_range, other=-float("inf"))
    x = tl.where(cols <= row, x, -float("inf"))
    m = tl.max(x, axis=0)
    e = tl.exp(x - m)          # exp(-inf - m) = 0 for masked lanes
    s = tl.sum(e, axis=0)
    tl.store(out_ptr + row * N + cols, e / s, mask=in_range)


def causal_softmax(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    assert x.is_contiguous() and x.dim() == 2 and x.shape[0] == x.shape[1]
    N = x.shape[0]
    out = torch.empty_like(x)
    BLOCK_N = triton.next_power_of_2(N)
    _causal_softmax_kernel[(N,)](x, out, N, BLOCK_N=BLOCK_N, num_warps=8)
    return out

Each domain has its own async active-low reset.

```verilog
// Toggle-based pulse synchronizer (source pulse may be narrower than clk_dst).
// Constraint: source pulses spaced >= ~3 clk_dst periods.
module pulse_toggle_sync (
    input  wire clk_src,
    input  wire rst_src_n,
    input  wire pulse_src,
    input  wire clk_dst,
    input  wire rst_dst_n,
    output reg  strobe_dst
);
    // Source domain: toggle flag on each pulse.
    reg toggle_src;
    always @(posedge clk_src or negedge rst_src_n) begin
        if (!rst_src_n)
            toggle_src <= 1'b0;
        else if (pulse_src)
            toggle_src <= ~toggle_src;
    end

    // Destination domain: 2-flop synchronizer + edge detect.
    reg sync_ff0, sync_ff1, sync_ff1_d;
    always @(posedge clk_dst or negedge rst_dst_n) begin
        if (!rst_dst_n) begin
            sync_ff0   <= 1'b0;
            sync_ff1   <= 1'b0;
            sync_ff1_d <= 1'b0;
            strobe_dst <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            sync_ff0   <= toggle_src;
            sync_ff1   <= sync_ff0;
            sync_ff1_d <= sync_ff1;
            strobe_dst <= sync_ff1 ^ sync_ff1_d;
        end
    end
endmodule
```
"""

            S1: next_state = din ? S1 : S2;
            S2: next_state = din ? S3 : S0;

        endcase
    end

RTL_TASK_2_ASSISTANT = """Bug analysis: there are two defects.

1. Missing `default` in the combinational `case`. For `state` values outside S0..S3 (impossible here since 2 bits encode exactly 4 states, but after a glitch/X in simulation) `next_state` holds its value, inferring a latch in the `always @(*)` block. Lint/synthesis flag this; add a `default: next_state = S0;`.

2. Wrong overlap fallback in S3. The pattern is 1011 with *overlapping* matches. In S3 we have consumed "101". On `din=0` the suffix "10" of "101" is a prefix of the pattern, so the machine must fall back to S2 (seen "10"), not restart at S0. The given code has `S3: next_state = din ? S1 : S2;` — actually the S3 transition itself is correct for overlap... the real bug is subtler: on `din=1` in S3 the machine completes a match ("1011") and the trailing "1" is again a valid prefix, so S1 is right; on `din=0`, "1010" ends with "10" -> S2 is right. So S3 is fine. Re-examine S2: after "10", on `din=0` we have "100" whose longest suffix that is a prefix of 1011 is "" -> S0 is correct. On `din=1` -> "101" -> S3 correct. S1: "1"+din=1 -> "11", longest suffix prefix is "1" -> S1 correct; din=0 -> "10" -> S2 correct. So the transition table is actually correct; the single functional bug is the missing `default` (latch inference), which in gate-level/X-propagation simulation makes `hit` go X. Additionally, `hit` uses `(state == S3) && din` — that asserts hit in the same cycle the final 1 is *sampled into next_state*, i.e. one cycle *early* relative to "after the final bit arrives" if you count state updates; but since state==S3 means 101 was seen and din is the 4th bit on this edge, the registered hit at the next edge is exactly one cycle after the final bit — this part is correct.

Fixed module:

```verilog
module seq_detect_1011 (
    input  wire clk,
    input  wire rst_n,
    input  wire din,
    output reg  hit
);
    localparam S0 = 2'd0; // no match
    localparam S1 = 2'd1; // seen 1
    localparam S2 = 2'd2; // seen 10
    localparam S3 = 2'd3; // seen 101

    reg [1:0] state, next_state;

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n)
            state <= S0;
        else
            state <= next_state;
    end

    always @(*) begin
        case (state)
            S0:      next_state = din ? S1 : S0;
            S1:      next_state = din ? S1 : S2;
            S2:      next_state = din ? S3 : S0;
            S3:      next_state = din ? S1 : S2;
            default: next_state = S0;   // was missing: latch inference / X propagation
        endcase
    end

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n)
            hit <= 1'b0;
        else
            hit <= (state == S3) && din;
    end
endmodule
```
"""

{"content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Machine-check the pilot seed batch.

- cuda_kernel seeds: exec the assistant's Triton code on GPU, compare against the
  PyTorch reference for multiple shapes/dtypes, report max error + do_bench speedup.
- rtl seeds: parse every Verilog block (buggy + fixed) with pyverilog (L0 check).

Run:  .venv/bin/python seeds/verify_seeds.py
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from pipelines.common.schema import read_jsonl  # noqa: E402

CODE_RE = re.compile(r"```(\w+)\n(.*?)```", re.DOTALL)


def last_code(text: str, lang: str) -> str:
    blocks = [m.group(2) for m in CODE_RE.finditer(text) if m.group(1) == lang]
    if not blocks:
        raise ValueError(f"no {lang} block found")
    return blocks[-1]


def check_cuda() -> bool:
    import torch

    assert torch.cuda.is_available(), "CUDA not available"
    rows = {r["id"]: r for r in read_jsonl(ROOT / "seeds/cuda_kernel_seeds.jsonl")}
    ok = True

    # --- seed 9001: silu + residual, bf16
    ns: dict = {}
    exec(compile(last_code(rows["cuda_kernel-9001"]["messages"][1]["content"], "python"),
                 "<seed9001>", "exec"), ns)
    fn = ns["silu_residual"]
    for n in (1 << 20, (1 << 20) + 997, (1 << 24) + 13):
        x = torch.randn(n, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
        res = torch.randn(n, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
        ref = x * torch.sigmoid(x) + res
        out = fn(x, res)
        err = (out.float() - ref.float()).abs().max().item()
        status = "PASS" if err <= 2e-2 else "FAIL"
        ok &= status == "PASS"
        print(f"[9001] n={n:>10}  max_err={err:.3e}  {status}")
    try:
        import triton
        n = 1 << 26
        x = torch.randn(n, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
        res = torch.randn(n, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
        t_ref = triton.testing.do_bench(lambda: x * torch.sigmoid(x) + res)
        t_new = triton.testing.do_bench(lambda: fn(x, res))
        print(f"[9001] do_bench n=2^26: ref={t_ref:.3f}ms new={t_new:.3f}ms "
              f"speedup={t_ref / t_new:.2f}x")
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        print(f"[9001] bench skipped: {e}")

    # --- seed 9002: causal softmax, fp32
    ns = {}
    exec(compile(last_code(rows["cuda_kernel-9002"]["messages"][1]["content"], "python"),
                 "<seed9002>", "exec"), ns)
    fn2 = ns["causal_softmax"]
    for n_ in (17, 128, 1000, 4096):
        x = torch.randn(n_, n_, dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
        causal = torch.tril(torch.ones(n_, n_, dtype=torch.bool, device="cuda"))
        ref = torch.softmax(x.masked_fill(~causal, float("-inf")), dim=-1)
        out = fn2(x)
        err = (out - ref).abs().max().item()
        status = "PASS" if err <= 1e-5 else "FAIL"
        ok &= status == "PASS"
        print(f"[9002] N={n_:>5}  max_err={err:.3e}  {status}")
    try:
        import triton
        n_ = 4096
        x = torch.randn(n_, n_, dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
        causal = torch.tril(torch.ones(n_, n_, dtype=torch.bool, device="cuda"))
        t_ref = triton.testing.do_bench(
            lambda: torch.softmax(x.masked_fill(~causal, float("-inf")), dim=-1))
        t_new = triton.testing.do_bench(lambda: fn2(x))
        print(f"[9002] do_bench N=4096: ref={t_ref:.3f}ms new={t_new:.3f}ms "
              f"speedup={t_ref / t_new:.2f}x")
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        print(f"[9002] bench skipped: {e}")
    return ok


def check_rtl() -> bool:
    from pyverilog.vparser.parser import VerilogParser

    rows = {r["id"]: r for r in read_jsonl(ROOT / "seeds/rtl_seeds.jsonl")}
    ok = True
    targets = [
        ("rtl-9001", [last_code(rows["rtl-9001"]["messages"][1]["content"], "verilog")]),
        ("rtl-9002", [last_code(rows["rtl-9002"]["messages"][0]["content"], "verilog"),
                      last_code(rows["rtl-9002"]["messages"][1]["content"], "verilog")]),
    ]
    parser = VerilogParser()
    for sid, blocks in targets:
        for i, code in enumerate(blocks):
            try:
                parser.parse(code)
                print(f"[{sid}] block{i}: pyverilog parse PASS ({len(code)} chars)")
            except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
                ok = False
                print(f"[{sid}] block{i}: pyverilog parse FAIL: {e}")
    return ok


def main() -> None:
    ok_cuda = check_cuda()
    ok_rtl = check_rtl()
    print(f"\nSUMMARY: cuda={'PASS' if ok_cuda else 'FAIL'} "
          f"rtl={'PASS' if ok_rtl else 'FAIL'}")
    sys.exit(0 if (ok_cuda and ok_rtl) else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

The bf16 reference itself has rounding: sigmoid in bf16, mul in bf16, add in bf16 → reference carries ~1e-2 error relative to true. My kernel is *more* accurate than the reference. The tolerance rtol=2e-2/atol=2e-2 with err 3.125e-02 (which is 2^-5, one bf16 ulp at magnitude ~16? values of x*sigmoid(x)+res can be large; err 0.03 at value magnitude ~8-16 is within rtol if rtol applied per-element. My check used only absolute max err ≤ 2e-2, ignoring rtol. The standard check is `torch.allclose(out, ref, rtol, atol)` i.e. |out-ref| ≤ atol + rtol*|ref|.

So the honest fix is in verify_seeds.py: use proper rtol+atol comparison (as the pipeline verifier does — it reported max_err differently). Two options:

{"content": "# posttrain_v4flash — DeepSeek-V4-Flash 后训练数据合成工程

> 目标:对齐 DeepSeek 官方 0731 版的后训练方法学(领域专家 SFT+GRPO → on-policy 蒸馏合并),自合成五条缺口数据管线,把 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 后训练到 0731 级 agentic 能力。
> 创建:2026-08-02 · 本机:3× H200(141GB)· 隔离环境 `.venv`(torch 2.13 / triton 3.7.1 / pyverilog)

## 目录

| 路径 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `docs/01_方法学调研_KimiK3_vs_Nemotron3Ultra.md` | 两份技术报告的后训练方法学全文梳理(QAT/SFT/RL/MOPD/MTP)与对比结论 |
| `docs/02_数据缺口分析.md` | Nemotron 3 Ultra 后训练数据开源完整性核查:已开源清单 + 22 项缺口清单 |
| `docs/03_合成pipeline方案.md` | 五条缺口的具体合成方案(数据源/流程/奖励/成本),总体路线图与 teacher 策略 |
| `pipelines/common/` | 统一 JSONL schema(SFT/RL)+ OpenAI 兼容 teacher client(env: `TEACHER_BASE_URL/API_KEY/MODEL`) |
| `pipelines/cuda_kernel/` | 8 个内置 kernel 任务 + GPU 验证器(正确性+do_bench 测速+反 hack)+ 合成循环 |
| `pipelines/long_context/` | RULER 式 needle/变量追踪/聚合/表格程序生成器(32K–1M 分桶)+ 多文档 QA |
| `pipelines/deep_search/` | WebShaper 式形式化多跳造题(92 实体 KB,2–6 跳,答案唯一性程序校验)+ mock harness |
| `pipelines/rtl/` | 3 个种子模块 + 6 类错误注入器 + pyverilog L0/iverilog L1 分级验证 + 自对赌 |
| `pipelines/office/` | K3 式 mock 应用(Gmail/日历/FS/表格)+ 8 职业任务卡 + 状态断言/rubric |
| `seeds/` | **Kimi 作为 T0 teacher 直接合成的试点批次**(8 条,全部机器验证通过) |

## 实测状态

| 组件 | 状态 | 实测结果 |
|---|---|---|
| cuda_kernel verifier | ✅ H200 实测 | 8 个内置任务自验证 8/8 PASS(speedup 1.13x–9.03x);dry-run 16 SFT + 8 RL 过 schema |

| long_context | ✅ 实测 | 32K/128K 桶 self-check 全过;多文档 dry-run 产出跨文档 QA |
| deep_search | ✅ 实测 | 2–6 跳 10/10 答案唯一且可求值;mock harness 轨迹 18 步跑通 |
| office | ✅ 实测 | 8 任务卡 35 条断言全过;rule+rubric 双 reward 产出 |

messages.content: LLM teacher 服务，是用哪个模型？

计划是用**学生模型自己**——`DeepSeek-V4-Flash`（已下载到 `~/models/DeepSeek-V4-Flash`)，即 T1 自举路线。理由：

**为什么主力 teacher 是 V4-Flash 自己（而不是更强的外部模型）**

1. **我们合成的五个域全部带程序化 verifier**(kernel 数值验证、RTL 仿真、needle/表格答案、搜索答案匹配、office 状态断言）。有可验证奖励时，teacher 不需要"比学生强"——rejection sampling 从学生自己的 k 个采样里筛出正确轨迹即可，这正是 K3/Ultra/DeepSeek 官方 RLVR 的做法。teacher 能力只影响通过率（产量），不影响数据正确性。
2. **分布天然对齐**:SFT 数据来自学生自己的输出分布，没有师生分布失配——就是 Nemotron 被迫发明 MOPD Warmup 来解决、而 K3 靠"专家同源冷启动"规避的那个问题。自蒸馏路线从设计上免疫。
3. **格式零损耗**:V4-Flash 用的是专用 `encoding_dsv4` 模板 + low/high/max 三档 reasoning_effort，用自己的模型合成，产出格式就是训练时的目标格式，不需要模板转换。
4. MIT license，无蒸馏限制；本地 8×H200,149G 权重 TP=8 跑，KV cache 充裕。

**gpt-oss-120b 的角色**:judge（非 verifiable 任务的 rubric 打分，比如 office 交付物质量、回答质量评估）+ 多样性对照。它是 Nemotron 的 SFT teacher 选择，Apache-2.0，单卡 H200 就能跑。两个模型可以同时在 8 卡上并存（V4-Flash 用 6–7 卡，gpt-oss 用 1 卡）。

**什么时候该换更强 teacher**：如果某个域 V4-Flash 的通过率太低（比如 50–100 跳深度搜索、复杂 SWE 任务），rejection sampling 产不出数据，那时再考虑 T2——DeepSeek API(V4-Pro）或其他强模型，只用于那几个难域的冷启动种子。

当前状态：vllm 还在容器里装（后台），装完我就用 TP=8 起 `vllm serve ~/models/DeepSeek-V4-Flash`(temperature=1.0, agentic top_p=0.95，对齐官方推荐）。如果你想直接用更强 teacher（比如走 DeepSeek API)，告诉我，我把 `TEACHER_BASE_URL` 切过去即可——pipeline 代码对 teacher 是无感的。

Profiles:
  kimi   — Kimi K3 via the Kimi CLI managed endpoint (OAuth Bearer read live from
           ~/.kimi-code/credentials/kimi-code.json; refreshed by the running CLI)

Usage (writes an env file; source it before running a pipeline):
  python3 -m pipelines.common.profiles kimi    # -> secrets/teacher.env (chmod 600)
  python3 -m pipelines.common.profiles copilot
  source secrets/teacher.env && python3 pipelines/.../synthesize.py ...

Never prints token material to stdout.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
SECRETS = ROOT / "secrets"
OUT_ENV = SECRETS / "teacher.env"

PROFILES = {
    "kimi": {
        "TEACHER_BASE_URL": "https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1",
        "TEACHER_MODEL": "k3",
    },
    "copilot": {
        "TEACHER_BASE_URL": "https://api.githubcopilot.com",
        "TEACHER_MODEL": "claude-opus-4.6",
    },
}


def kimi_token() -> str:
    cred = json.load(open(Path.home() / ".kimi-code/credentials/kimi-code.json"))
    if int(cred.get("expires_at", 0)) < time.time() + 60:
        raise SystemExit("kimi access_token expired or near expiry; "
                         "run any kimi CLI command to refresh, then retry")
    return cred["access_token"]


def copilot_token() -> str:
    cache = SECRETS / ".copilot_session"
    if cache.exists():
        try:
            d = json.loads(cache.read_text())
            if int(d.get("expires_at", 0)) > time.time() + 120:
                return d["token"]
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            pass
    gho = (SECRETS / "copilot_gho").read_text().strip()
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        "https://api.github.com/copilot_internal/v2/token",
        headers={"Authorization": f"token {gho}", "Accept": "application/json"},
    )
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
        d = json.loads(resp.read())
    cache.write_text(json.dumps({"token": d["token"], "expires_at": d["expires_at"]}))
    os.chmod(cache, 0o600)
    return d["token"]


def main() -> None:
    name = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ""
    if name not in PROFILES:
        raise SystemExit(f"usage: profiles.py [{'|'.join(PROFILES)}]")
    token = kimi_token() if name == "kimi" else copilot_token()
    lines = [f"{k}={v}" for k, v in PROFILES[name].items()]
    lines.append(f"TEACHER_API_KEY={token}")
    OUT_ENV.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
    os.chmod(OUT_ENV, 0o600)
    print(f"wrote {OUT_ENV} (profile={name}, model={PROFILES[name]['TEACHER_MODEL']})")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

{"content": """"Copilot CLI teacher backend: drives the authenticated Copilot CLI inside the
lkk-ki container (bc1c6d867f20) as an OpenAI-style chat teacher.

Why this exists: the GitHub Copilot token-exchange endpoint is blocked on this
network (HTTP 403 at api.github.com/copilot_internal/v2/token), but the Copilot
CLI in the container is authenticated and works. Each call is a fresh headless
session:

  docker exec bc1c6d867f20 copilot -p <prompt> --model claude-opus-4.6 -s \
      --no-custom-instructions --no-ask-user --allow-all-tools

Notes:
- ~24k input tokens of CLI system-prompt overhead per call, billed as AI credits.
- No multi-turn state across calls; messages are flattened into one prompt.
- Throughput ~5–30 s/call; parallelize at the caller level if needed.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import subprocess
import time

CONTAINER = os.environ.get("COPILOT_CONTAINER", "bc1c6d867f20")
DEFAULT_MODEL = os.environ.get("TEACHER_MODEL", "claude-opus-4.6")


def flatten(messages: list[dict[str, str]]) -> str:
    parts: list[str] = []
    for m in messages:
        role = m.get("role", "user")
        content = m.get("content", "")
        if role == "system":
            parts.append(f"[SYSTEM INSTRUCTIONS]\n{content}\n[/SYSTEM INSTRUCTIONS]")
        elif role == "assistant":
            parts.append(f"[ASSISTANT EXAMPLE]\n{content}\n[/ASSISTANT EXAMPLE]")
        else:
            parts.append(content)
    return "\n\n".join(parts)


def chat(messages: list[dict[str, str]], *, model: str | None = None,
         retries: int = 2, backoff: float = 5.0, timeout: int = 900,
         max_prompt_chars: int = 400_000) -> str:
    prompt = flatten(messages)
    if len(prompt) > max_prompt_chars:
        raise ValueError(f"prompt too long for CLI backend: {len(prompt)} chars")
    cmd = [
        "docker", "exec", CONTAINER, "copilot",
        "-p", prompt,
        "--model", model or DEFAULT_MODEL,
        "-s", "--no-custom-instructions", "--no-ask-user", "--allow-all-tools",
    ]
    last_err: Exception | None = None
    for attempt in range(retries + 1):
        try:
            r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
            if r.returncode == 0 and r.stdout.strip():
                return r.stdout.strip()
            last_err = RuntimeError(f"rc={r.returncode} stderr={r.stderr[:300]}")
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            last_err = e
        if attempt < retries:
            time.sleep(backoff * (attempt + 1))
    raise RuntimeError(f"copilot-cli teacher failed: {last_err}")
